headline.story_zh:
这件东西解决的是所有 AI 推理游戏的通病：**模型能被说服**。你追问几轮、换个角度施压，它就开始改口——凶手是谁取决于你问得多凶，而不是案子本身。

它的做法是把答案从模型手里拿走。开局由脚本生成案件，凶手随机定死，然后**当场算一个 SHA-256 交给你**。作者管这叫 proof-of-honesty，并且要求把哈希原样展示给玩家——**你手上有凭据，模型改不了口，改了你验得出来**。模型在这局里只是舞台：你问谁，它就照那张嫌疑人卡演谁，卡上写着这人的假不在场证明、会回避什么、会撒哪个谎。它连自己在演的是不是凶手都不知道。

真正让我服气的是困难模式。它会塞进一个**指错人的第二证人**——而扮演那个证人的模型，自己也不知道那是假的。所以你没法靠察言观色，只能交叉比对不在场证明。一个把「连我自己都被蒙在鼓里」写进设计的游戏，比任何「我保证不剧透」的承诺都可靠。

它还写了一节「什么时候别用我」：多线战役、开放世界跑团、想写推理小说而不是玩、真实罪案和现实人物——一律礼貌拒绝，也不接非黑色电影的题材。**一个只做一件事、并且把不做的事列出来的小游戏。**

不适合谁：想玩长线战役的人。它就是一局 5 到 15 分钟，打完那个案子文件就结了。

item.name: noir-interrogation
item.title_zh: 审问式追问，直到你交出真需求
item.tagline_zh: 玩推理最怕 AI 中途被你说服改口。这个把答案的哈希公示在开场简报里，你一间间审嫌疑人，它只照脚本发的卡演。
item.tagline_en: What ruins AI mysteries is talking the model out of its own answer. Here the solution is SHA-256 committed in the opening briefing, and every suspect is played strictly off a card the script hands over.
item.why_zh: 困难模式会塞进一个指错人的假证人。
item.why_en: Hard mode plants a second witness who names the wrong person, and the model playing that suspect is not told the statement is false either.
item.limit_zh: 一局 5–15 分钟，单场结束就完，不做多线战役。只有黑色电影一种类型，中途要奇幻或科幻会被拒绝；两套设定是 1940 年代美式与 1930 年代民国上海。作者明写不许 agent 去 Read 或 cat 案件 JSON，一旦绕过脚本。
item.limit_en: One case runs 5–15 minutes and ends there; no campaigns. Noir only — fantasy or sci-fi requests are declined — in two settings, 1940s America and 1930s Shanghai. The file forbids the agent from ever reading or cat-ing the case JSON, since bypassing the script defeats the whole design.

headline_history.story_zh:
今天这件的招牌是一条自我约束：不调任何图像生成模型。给它一张你自己拍的照片，它用手写 HTML/CSS/SVG 把画面重新画一遍，无头 Chrome 导出 PNG——成品里一个照片像素都没有。

为什么这算品味而不是自找麻烦：所有效果都来自可控的代码，所以出品是稳定的，不是抽卡抽出来的。作者把方法论写得比多数设计文档还狠——「如果观者还在数花瓣，画的就仍是物体」；采样时明令不采轮廓，因为「采了就会忍不住去画」，他还记下了实测：树梢的 141 个锯齿点，让一道横痕被画成了山。

最让我服气的是那条盲画协议。开工先自测三件事，其中一件是「你能看见渲染出来的 PNG 吗」——检验方式是渲染后用一句话说出画面里的三个东西，说不出就是看不见。看不见时强制进入盲画模式：第一版画完立刻交人，此后每一轮改动只能由用户反馈驱动，自发迭代次数为零。一个作者肯把「我的 agent 可能看不见自己画了什么」写进流程并给出降级路径，比任何效果图都更能说明他在乎。

不适合谁：本机跑不了无头 Chrome 和 PIL 的人。缺一样它就降级成交你一个 HTML 文件、颜色请你自己报，手机上基本用不了。

skills.name: tianming-novel-system
skills.title_zh: 七卷本起步的协同写作系统，大纲到存档全管
skills.tagline_zh: 写长篇最怕前后矛盾、伏笔烂尾。这套系统用外部知识库锁死世界观和文风，每章动笔前先体检，节奏失控会直接叫停。
skills.tagline_en: Long-form novels fall apart on contradictions and dropped threads. This system locks world and style via external.
skills.desc_en: 「天命」长篇小说协同创作系统。当用户使用「天命：大纲」「天命：规划」「天命：目录」 「天命：草案」「天命：正文」「天命：体检」「天命：存档」等指令进行多卷长篇小说写作， 或需要保证跨章节的世界观一致性、伏笔回收、节奏控制、文风稳定时使用本 Skill。 本系统依赖外部知识库：《世界基石.md》《世界观规则.md》《角色档案.md》《档案事件.md》《文风样本.md》。
skills.why_zh: 它把写作拆成七个指令，每个阶段都强制对照《世界基石》《角色档案》等知识库。

skills.name: yingzao
skills.title_zh: 实景照片转艺术海报，附原图对比不空想
skills.tagline_zh: 拍过老街、老店、老宅却总出不来高级感？它把照片重排成杂志跨页，还能拼多图场景，附原图对比。
skills.tagline_en: Shot real alleys, shops, or heritage sites but got flat results? It re-lays your photos into editorial spreads.
skills.desc_en: Transform real Chinese architecture and place-based cultural photos into art-directed editorial posters, integrated multi-photo scenes, and optional source comparisons. Use for historic buildings, vernacular streets, culturally rooted shops, interiors, food, travel covers, and place montages; do not use for generic advertising, routine retouching, or invented places.
skills.why_zh: 不是滤镜堆叠，而是按建筑类型与地域文化做版式决策：构图、留白、字距都服务于场所精神。
skills.why_en: Not a filter stack—it makes layout decisions per building type and regional culture: composition, whitespace, and letter-spacing.
skills.limit_zh: 只处理真实存在的中国建筑/街景/文化场所照片；虚构场景、纯商业广告、普通磨皮修图它会乱来。输入需是照片而非草图。
skills.limit_en: Only for real Chinese architecture/streets/cultural sites; fictional scenes, generic ads, or routine retouching will misfire. Needs photos (not.
skills.title_en: Real photos into art posters, with source comparison

skills.name: nature-writing-studio
skills.title_zh: 657 篇 Nature 原文蒸馏出的学术英语改写器
skills.tagline_zh: 投 Nature 前，摘要和引言总被批「不够 native」。它用 657 篇原文逐篇观察出的语料库改写。
skills.tagline_en: Before you submit, your abstract gets flagged 'not native'. This rewrites using patterns from 657 Nature.
skills.desc_en: Rewrite scientific text into Nature Portfolio English using a knowledge base distilled from 657 Nature family papers via per-paper LLM observation (87.6% coverage), now extended with 5 deterministic AI-observation TSVs (gap_transitions / opener_distribution / cross_section_linkers / hedge_verbs / results_discussion_openers) from 412 v3 Nature papers via MiniMax-M3 per-paper observation. Trigger fo
skills.why_zh: 不是通用润色，是 87.6% 覆盖率的逐篇观察知识库，外加 5 个确定性 TSV（gap 转换。
skills.why_en: Not generic polishing—a per-paper observation KB with 87.6% coverage, plus 5 deterministic TSVs for gap transitions, openers.
skills.limit_zh: 只改写科学文本为 Nature Portfolio 风格，不生成新内容；需输入英文或可翻译的学术草稿；不处理图表。
skills.limit_en: Rewrites only scientific text into Nature Portfolio style; no new content generation. Needs English or translatable draft. No figures/references.
skills.title_en: Nature-style English rewriter distilled from 657 papers

skills.name: styleseed
skills.title_zh: 只认当前画布边界，把 StyleSeed 请求派给唯
skills.tagline_zh: 你说「帮我弄下风格」时，它先分清你在改哪张图、哪段文，再只调对应那套 ss-* 技能——不让你在六个相似入口里瞎猜。
skills.tagline_en: When you say "help with StyleSeed," it checks which artifact you're editing, then calls only the matching ss-*.
skills.desc_en: Route a StyleSeed request to exactly one first workflow after resolving the current artifact boundary. Use when the user asks generally for StyleSeed help rather than invoking one specific ss-* skill.
skills.why_zh: 别的路由靠关键词猜意图，它靠解析当前画布边界做硬判断——边界没变就锁死同一流程，变了才换，杜绝误调。
skills.why_en: Others guess intent by keywords; this one resolves the artifact boundary first and locks the workflow until that boundary.
skills.limit_zh: 只做路由，不执行任何风格操作。若当前画布为空或边界模糊（如同时选中多类对象），它会停下问你，不会替你选。
skills.limit_en: Routes only, never applies styles. If canvas is empty or boundary ambiguous (multi-type selection), it stops and asks—won't guess.
skills.title_en: Route StyleSeed to the one right workflow, by artifact.

skills.name: academic-figures-drawer
skills.title_zh: 论文配图直接产出可编辑 draw.io 源文件
skills.tagline_zh: 从摘要、代码或参考图出发，生成 ICML/NeurIPS 级别的框架图、张量流、消融对比图。改字体、调颜色。
skills.tagline_en: From abstracts, code, or reference images to camera-ready framework diagrams, tensor flows, and ablation.
skills.desc_en: Create camera-ready, editable draw.io figures from papers, method descriptions, code, or reference images. Use for ICML, NeurIPS/NIPS, ICLR, and similar ML/AI research figures: concise framework overviews, module-detail diagrams, tensor and attention flows, ablations, training/inference pipelines, and downstream-task panels. Optionally use image generation for a non-semantic visual concept or inpu
skills.why_zh: 它把「看懂论文结构」和「画图」拆开：先解析你的方法描述，再映射成 draw.io 的图层与连线。
skills.why_en: It separates understanding from drawing: parses your method description, maps it to draw.io layers and connectors, outputs.
skills.limit_zh: 只认机器学习/深度学习论文的常见图型（框架、模块、张量流、消融、流程）。不处理复杂数学公式排版、不生成矢量插图风格。
skills.limit_en: Only for standard ML/DL figure types (frameworks, modules, tensor flows, ablations, pipelines). No complex math typesetting, no freehand.
skills.title_en: Turn paper ideas into editable draw.io figures

skills.name: cumcm-c-problem
skills.title_zh: C题专用：从附件到LaTeX成稿的72小时全流程建模
skills.tagline_zh: 只认国赛C题，不碰A/B/D/E。从选题判断到评委视角终检，连LaTeX代码工程都替你生成，省下通宵排版的命。
skills.tagline_en: For C题 only. From problem selection to judge-perspective final check, it generates LaTeX and code projects—saving.
skills.desc_en: 专门用于全国大学生数学建模竞赛（CUMCM）本科组 C 题的选题判断、数据分析、模型设计、算法求解、创新设计、可视化、论文写作、LaTeX 成稿与评委视角终检。用于用户要求解决或复盘国赛 C 题、根据附件建立 C 题模型、设计 72 小时方案、撰写/修改 C 题论文、生成完整 LaTeX+代码工程、评估 C 题论文竞争力时。只服务 C 题；不要将 A/B/D/E 题套路机械迁入。
skills.why_zh: 内置评委视角终检机制，每一步都对照评分标准自查；72小时方案按比赛节奏倒排。
skills.why_en: Built-in judge-perspective review mirrors scoring rubrics at every step; 72h plan is reverse-scheduled from deadline, so you.
skills.limit_zh: 只服务C题（本科组），不处理A/B/D/E题套路；需要用户提供附件数据或明确题目背景，不负责从零虚构赛题。
skills.limit_en: C题 only (undergrad). Needs your attached data/problem context—won't invent one. Output stops at LaTeX+code; no plagiarism-check or submission support.
skills.title_en: CUMCM Problem C specialist: data to LaTeX paper in 72h

skills.name: generating-memes
skills.title_zh: 298 个模板随叫随到，连 petpet 都能现做
skills.tagline_zh: 不用打开网页找模板，命令行里搜、预览、生成一步到位。自带 298 个经典梗图，连 petpet、slap。
skills.tagline_en: Skip the browser hunt—search, preview, and generate from 298 templates right in your terminal, including animated.
skills.desc_en: Creates memes using the meme CLI with 298 templates. Generates, previews, searches, and lists meme templates. Use when user asks to make memes, create memes, generate memes, or mentions specific meme names like petpet, slap, hug, rub, etc.
skills.why_zh: 它把 meme CLI 的完整能力包成 Skill，不用记命令参数，说人话就能调。模板库离线可用。
skills.why_en: Wraps the full meme CLI into a natural-language Skill—no flags to memorize. Offline template library with.
skills.limit_zh: 只认 meme CLI 支持的 298 个模板，超出范围会报错；需要本机已安装 meme CLI 且能联网下载模板。
skills.limit_en: Only works with the 298 templates supported by meme CLI; requires meme CLI installed locally and internet for template downloads; outputs static.
skills.title_en: 298 meme templates on call, even petpet on demand

skills.name: reference-first-motion-director
skills.title_zh: 先出整片视觉总表，再逐镜找参考的导演工作流
skills.tagline_zh: 口播稿不直接进剪辑，先路由成人物/证据/录屏/素材四类镜头，存好总表和动效清单，再为每镜检索精确参考。
skills.tagline_en: Don't cut talking-head raw. Route script into人物/证据/录屏/素材 shots, save a master visual plan, then fetch exact.
skills.desc_en: 以本地《剪辑学习》知识库为依据的整片视觉导演与动态包装工作流。用于把口播脚本、字幕或文案路由为人物、真实证据、录屏、现有素材与重点动效；先保存整片视觉总表和动效清单，再为每个选定单元检索精确参考，交付一张严格 2K 的成片级参考图和一条按内容定时的 AI 视频提示词。也用于吸收、归档和分析用户新增的图片或视频参考。用户提到视觉导演、整片画面规划、动效参考、先出图、MiniMax/H3 视频提示词或补充案例库时使用。
skills.why_zh: 先定整片视觉骨架再逐镜找参考，避免边剪边想导致的风格漂移；本地知识库让参考检索可追溯、可复用。
skills.why_en: Locks the film's visual skeleton before per-shot reference hunting, preventing style drift mid-edit. Local knowledge base makes.
skills.limit_zh: 只认本地《剪辑学习》知识库，未先建库或库内无对应案例时它不会硬编；产物止于 2K 参考图和视频提示词。
skills.limit_en: Requires local '剪辑学习' KB; won't fabricate refs if absent. Output ends at 2K still + video prompt — no actual edit/composite. Timing needs a script.
skills.title_en: Visual-director workflow: shot list first, then per-shot.

skills.name: native-subtitle-quote-image
skills.title_zh: 视频字幕截图直接拼社交长图，不重绘不超分
skills.tagline_zh: 别再用播放器截图拼图了。它从视频帧里取原生字幕，自动裁切、拼成 3:4 长图，连台词间隔和主图比例都替你调好。
skills.tagline_en: Stop screenshotting players. It grabs native subtitle frames, crops, and tiles them into 3:4 quote cards—spacing.
skills.desc_en: 将本地视频或用户有权处理的在线视频，经过来源获取、文字稿定位、选题选句、精确取帧、紧凑裁切、3:4 拼图和逐张质检，制作成视频字幕社交长图。支持两种明确分开的输出：保留画面内已烧录字幕的原生字幕模式，以及把已审核的时间点与台词绘制到真实视频帧上的脚本字幕模式。用户要求原生字幕截图、字幕帧拼图、YouTube 金句长图、台词截图、不重绘字幕、自定义中文台词，或调整主图比例、字幕区域、台词间隔和美感时使用。
skills.why_zh: 把「选句→取帧→裁切→拼图」做成一条流水线，且原生字幕与脚本字幕两种模式严格分开，不混不糊。
skills.why_en: A pipeline from quote-picking to frame-grabbing to tiling, with native and scripted subtitle modes kept strictly apart—each card.
skills.limit_zh: 只认本地视频或你有权处理的在线视频；字幕必须已烧录在画面内，外挂字幕不取。输出为 3:4 长图，不做竖版单图。
skills.limit_en: Local or rights-cleared online videos only; subtitles must be burned in. Output is 3:4 tiled images—no vertical singles, no blur fixing.
skills.title_en: Turn video subtitles into social-ready quote images

skills.name: code-review
skills.title_zh: 合代码前先过一遍仓库规矩的 gh 评审员
skills.tagline_zh: PR 一上来就按你仓库的约定逐条核对，不靠通用模板。它先读 CONTRIBUTING 和现有代码风格，再挑刺。
skills.tagline_en: Checks each PR against your codebase's stated rules, not generic templates. Reads CONTRIBUTING and code style.
skills.desc_en: Reviews GitHub CLI (gh) pull requests against codebase conventions
skills.why_zh: 它不套通用规则，而是先解析仓库里的约定文件，再对照 PR 逐项检查，像老同事一样懂你们项目的脾气。
skills.why_en: It adapts to your project's conventions instead of applying generic rules, parsing local docs and style to catch what matters to.
skills.limit_zh: 只针对 GitHub CLI 的 PR 做静态审查，不跑测试、不查运行时问题；需要仓库有明确的约定文档。
skills.limit_en: Only static review of gh PRs; no tests or runtime checks. Needs explicit convention docs in repo, else advice stays generic.
skills.title_en: A gh reviewer that checks PRs against repo rules

skills.name: duizuo-reading-companion
skills.title_zh: 读书记不住进度？它替你记着，还防剧透
skills.tagline_zh: 小说、散文、非虚构都能陪读。它记住你读到哪、什么感受，下次接着聊，绝不提前剧透。读不下去时，它会问你怎么了。
skills.tagline_en: For novels, essays, nonfiction. It tracks where you are and how you feel, picks up next time, and won't spoil a.
skills.desc_en: Stateful, spoiler-safe reading companionship for novels, short-story and essay collections, mixed anthologies, and nonfiction. Use when the reader is preparing to read, reading, stuck, reacting, interpreting, evaluating, or debriefing a book. It remembers edition, medium, status, and content-appropriate progress; verifies text claims; adapts each turn to plot, emotion, aesthetics, interpretation,
skills.why_zh: 它把读书变成有状态的对话：记得版本、媒介、进度，还能验证文本细节。每次回应都贴合当下情节。
skills.why_en: Stateful, spoiler-safe reading chats. It remembers edition, medium, and progress, verifies text claims, and adapts to plot.
skills.limit_zh: 只支持文本类书籍，不处理有声书或视频；需要你主动汇报进度，它不会自动翻页；对长篇复杂情节的跨章记忆有限。
skills.limit_en: Text-only; no audiobooks/video. You must report progress; it won't auto-sync. Cross-chapter memory is limited; very long books may need manual resets.
skills.title_en: A reading companion that remembers your place and never.

skills.name: agentmemory-agents
skills.title_zh: 只认官方适配器，装错路径当场报错的内存接线员
skills.tagline_zh: 装 agentmemory 到宿主编码 agent 时，它替你核对 connect 命令该写哪个配置路径。
skills.tagline_en: When wiring agentmemory into a host coding agent, it double-checks which config path the connect command should.
skills.desc_en: How agentmemory wires into host coding agents via the connect command. Use when installing agentmemory into a specific agent, when asked which agents are supported, or when a connect adapter writes the wrong config path.
skills.why_zh: 机制上它不猜：每个 connect 适配器都带白名单路径校验，写错位置直接停下告诉你。
skills.why_en: It never guesses: every connect adapter ships with whitelisted path validation, halting on mismatch instead of silently writing.
skills.limit_zh: 只管 agentmemory 的 connect 接线，不覆盖记忆检索、存储或向量化逻辑。只认官方列出的宿主 agen。
skills.limit_en: Only handles agentmemory's connect wiring; no retrieval/storage/vector logic. Supports only officially listed host agents; custom agents need your.
skills.title_en: Memory wiring that rejects wrong adapter paths

skills.name: xiaoou-gzh-layout
skills.title_zh: Markdown 进去，公众号编辑器样式直接粘贴出来
skills.tagline_zh: Word、PDF、纯文本都能进，按你的主题偏好自动配好章节编号、引言卡片、代码块和署名区。
skills.tagline_en: Accepts Word, PDF, or plain text. Auto-applies your theme: section numbers, callouts, code blocks, TOC.
skills.desc_en: 微信公众号文章排版引擎，将 Markdown、Word、PDF 或纯文本转换为可直接粘贴到公众号编辑器的 HTML，并按 xiaoou 的排版偏好选择主题、章节编号、关键词标记、引言卡片、目录、代码块、图片/GIF 和署名区。用户提到公众号排版、微信排版、自动排版、一键排版、gzh，或要求生成自定义公众号主题时使用。不用于普通网页、落地页、PPT 或代写文章。
skills.why_zh: 它把排版偏好固化成主题，输入杂格式、输出统一风格；目录、关键词标记、图片/GIF 位置都替你决定好。
skills.why_en: Encodes your layout taste into a reusable theme. Mixed inputs, one consistent visual voice. It decides structure details so you.
skills.limit_zh: 只输出公众号编辑器可粘贴的 HTML，不负责生成图片、不处理复杂表格、不适用于普通网页或 PPT。
skills.limit_en: Outputs paste-ready HTML for WeChat editor only. No image generation, no complex tables, not for web pages or PPT. Final preview in editor required.
skills.title_en: Markdown in, WeChat editor-ready styled HTML out

skills.name: doubao-multimodal
skills.title_zh: 音视频丢给它，回来的是字幕、时间轴和谁在说话
skills.tagline_zh: 开会录音、采访视频、技术讲座——不用本地装 Whisper，豆包多模态直接出带时间戳的字幕、说话人分离和关键帧。
skills.tagline_en: No local Whisper needed. Send meeting recordings or videos to Doubao-Seed and get timestamped subtitles, speaker.
skills.desc_en: Async audio/video understanding with Doubao-Seed (火山方舟 Ark). Handles ASR (plain / per-character timestamps / multispeaker), AST translation, speaker diarization, subtitle alignment, audio-visual captioning, video timeline JSON, technical-blog keyframe selection (with optional transcript hint), and free-form prompts over an audio or video file. Auto-uploads local files to Volcano TOS and auto-downl
skills.why_zh: 它把火山方舟的多模态能力包成了顺手工具：自动传 TOS、自动下载结果，ASR 还分纯文本/逐字时间戳/。
skills.why_en: Wraps Doubao-Seed's multimodal API into a smooth pipeline: auto-upload to TOS, auto-fetch results, and ASR with three.
skills.limit_zh: 只认火山方舟的豆包模型，需要你已有 Ark API Key 且开通 TOS 存储；本地文件必须能上传。
skills.limit_en: Requires Volcano Ark API key + TOS bucket. Local file upload size limited by bandwidth/TOS chunks. Subtitle alignment is timeline-based only, no.
skills.title_en: Drop audio/video, get subtitles, timeline & speaker labels

skills.name: chinese-font-selector
skills.title_zh: 中文字体选配不靠眼缘，靠授权安全分级和场景矩阵
skills.tagline_zh: 小红书卡片、产品册、网页、图书、海报——每个场景先查授权再谈气质。内置 OFL 铁稳/厂商免费/慎用三级，避头尾。
skills.tagline_en: From Xiaohongshu cards to book layouts—license check before style talk. OFL-safe / vendor-free / caution tiers.
skills.desc_en: 中文字体选配与排版决策专家。为中文为主的设计场景（小红书卡片、产品册/宣传物料、 网页/UI、图书内页排版、海报标题）选择可免费商用的中文字体并给出中英混排方案。 内置授权安全分级（开源 OFL 铁稳 / 厂商免费商用 / 慎用），场景×气质选字矩阵， 中文排版规则（字号阶梯、行距、标点、避头尾）。当用户要求"选字体/字体搭配/字体推荐/ 中文排版/小红书字体/产品册字体/网页字体/标题字体"，或任何中文视觉设计任务涉及字体 决策时触发。Triggers on: 中文字体, 中文字体推荐, 字体选择, 字体搭配, 字体配对, 字体筛选, 字体审美, 免费商用字体, 可商用字体, 开源字体, 思源黑体, 思源宋体, 霞鹜文楷, 得意黑, 中文排版, 中英混排, 小红书字体, 海报字体, 标题字体, Chinese font, Chinese typography, CJK fonts, Ch
skills.why_zh: 不拿审美当借口跳过法律风险。把字体决策拆成授权安全、场景气质、排版规则三层，先筛掉不能商用的。
skills.why_en: Refuses to let taste skip legal risk. Splits font choice into license safety, scene tone, and typography rules—filters out.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆盖中文为主的设计场景，不含纯英文排版、品牌 VI 全案、动态字体。免费商用判断基于内置库。
skills.limit_en: Chinese-first layouts only; no pure-Latin type, VI systems, or motion type. License data frozen at 2026—new fonts or license changes need manual.
skills.title_en: Chinese font pairing with license safety tiers & scene.

skills.name: dataset-curation
skills.title_zh: 会先问『这数据对谁不公平』的数据集体检员
skills.tagline_zh: 别人只报准确率，它先查性别、地域、收入分层是否失衡。自动生成分层采样方案，连采集计划里的伦理坑都标出来。
skills.tagline_en: While others report accuracy, it flags gender, region, income imbalances. Auto-generates stratified sampling.
skills.desc_en: Use when the user wants to analyze dataset bias, create stratified samples, evaluate fairness, or plan dataset collection. Triggers on phrases like "dataset bias", "stratified sample", "class imbalance", "data distribution", "fairness analysis", or "ethical review".
skills.why_zh: 不是事后补救，而是从源头盯住偏见：把『公平』拆成可计算的分布差异指标，让每个采样决策都带着伦理尺子。
skills.why_en: Proactive bias detection: turns 'fairness' into measurable distribution gaps, guiding every sampling choice with an ethical ruler.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆盖表格型数据，不处理图像/文本；需提供敏感属性列名，否则无法分析；输出为报告与建议，不自动修改数据。
skills.limit_en: Tabular data only; needs sensitive attribute column names; outputs report & suggestions, no auto-fixes.
skills.title_en: Dataset Auditor That Asks 'Who Does This Data Unfairly.

skills.name: kimi
skills.title_zh: 设计稿交给它，前端代码拿回来就能跑
skills.tagline_zh: 本地 Kimi Code CLI 的非交互封装，专治视觉方向、设计系统、界面评审和前端打磨。能看本地图和视频。
skills.tagline_en: A non-interactive wrapper for the local Kimi Code CLI, strong at visual direction, design systems, UI critique.
skills.desc_en: Delegate design-heavy UI/UX work, frontend implementation, coding, repository exploration, review, and media-aware analysis to the local Kimi Code CLI through a bundled non-interactive wrapper. Kimi is a design-strong Agent suited to visual direction, design systems, interface critique, and frontend polish. It can inspect local images and videos but cannot generate or edit image assets. Invoke onl
skills.why_zh: 把 Kimi 的设计判断力直接接进你的工作流，不用开 IDE、不用陪聊。它懂界面好坏，能审仓库。
skills.why_en: Bridges Kimi's design judgment straight into your pipeline—no IDE, no chit-chat. It critiques UI, explores repos, and writes.
skills.limit_zh: 只认 Kimi Code CLI 且需预先登录；不能生成或编辑图片素材，只能分析已有的本地图和视频。
skills.limit_en: Requires pre-authenticated Kimi Code CLI; cannot generate or edit image assets, only analyze existing local ones; non-interactive—no follow-up.
skills.title_en: Hand it the design, get back runnable frontend code

skills.name: vintage-travel-ticket
skills.title_zh: 66 张老车票里抽一套设计语法，每次出票都像翻到旧藏
skills.tagline_zh: 从 66 张历史票据里蒸馏出的设计语法：结构原型、插画语言、配色、纸张、字体、信息格式、印刷老化，每次随机选一套自洽的组合。
skills.tagline_en: A design grammar distilled from 66 historical tickets — archetype, illustration, palette, paper, type, information layout, print ageing — one coherent set picked at random each time.
skills.desc_en: A design grammar distilled from 66 historical tickets — archetype, illustration, palette, paper, type, information layout, print ageing — one coherent set picked at random each time.
skills.why_zh: 它生成前先核对景点或食物的官方名称，票面上的字是查过的。
skills.why_en: It verifies the official place or food name before generating; the words on the ticket are checked, not invented.
skills.limit_zh: 只出一张成品票，不出可编辑源文件。那 66 张参考图作者没有随仓分发，你拿到的只是从中提炼的规则。组合是随机选的，想指定某种风格得自己改提示。
skills.limit_en: One finished ticket, no editable source. The 66 reference images are not distributed.
skills.title_en: A random vintage ticket grammar from 66 real ones, every.

skills.name: outsider-art
skills.title_zh: 大色块平涂加手工纹理，小人做日常事，只留一个高饱和点
skills.tagline_zh: 大块平涂色区，每区一种手工纹理（窗格点阵、缝线虚线、织纹颗粒、墨线轮廓），撒满做日常事的无脸小人。纸白、暖墨黑、2–4 个场景色，外加恰好一个饱和高亮色。
skills.tagline_en: Large flat color zones each carrying one hand-made texture, tiny faceless silhouette figures doing ordinary things; paper white, warm ink black, 2–4 scene colors plus exactly one saturated highlight.
skills.desc_en: Large flat color zones each carrying one hand-made texture, tiny faceless silhouette figures doing ordinary things; paper white, warm ink black, 2–4 scene colors plus exactly one saturated highlight.
skills.why_zh: 那「恰好一个高亮色」必须真的在构图里干活，不是点缀——它把民间艺术的天真感变成了可执行的约束。
skills.why_en: That single highlight must do real compositional work — it turns folk-art naivety into an executable constraint.
skills.limit_zh: 小人是实心剪影、无脸、不许是火柴人——作者反复强调。照片只当语义参考，不复制细节。仓里 3 个 SKILL.md，这件是 outsider-art。
skills.limit_en: Figures are solid silhouettes, faceless, never stick figures. The photo is a semantic reference only. One of three skills in the repo.
skills.title_en: Flat color blocks with hand-made texture, tiny.

skills.name: clawteam-directors-orchestrator
skills.title_zh: 31位导演的分镜会，你当主席还是当观众
skills.tagline_zh: 写剧本卡在第三幕？让库布里克和诺兰在后台吵一架，你只负责拍板。多智能体辩论投票，每次产出都带导演署名和理由。
skills.tagline_en: Stuck at Act III? Let Kubrick and Nolan argue in the background while you just call the shots. Multi-agent debate.
skills.desc_en: ClawTeam导演智囊团——基于ClawTeam多智能体框架的世界著名导演协同创作系统。 整合31位全球顶级导演的风格思想，通过多智能体协作机制（顺序链、辩论投票、主席团模式） 辅助剧本创作、影像风格设计和叙事决策。 触发词：「导演智囊团」「ClawTeam」「多导演协作」「剧本创作」「影像风格」 适用场景：编剧、导演、创意策划、影视教育、AI影像创作
skills.why_zh: 不是风格混搭，是机制性对抗：顺序链推剧情、辩论投票逼出冲突、主席团模式强制收敛。
skills.why_en: Not style blending but engineered conflict: sequential chains push plot, debate votes force clashes, chair mode converges. Every.
skills.limit_zh: 只输出创作建议与分镜描述，不生成可直接拍摄的完整剧本格式（无场景编号/对白格式规范）。
skills.limit_en: Outputs creative suggestions & shot descriptions only, not production-ready script format (no scene numbers/dialogue specs). You must integrate into.
skills.title_en: 31 directors' storyboard meeting, you chair or watch

skills.name: lieflat-less-ai-tone
skills.title_zh: 只删清单上那七种AI腔，其余一字不动
skills.tagline_zh: 成稿后过一遍，把「值得注意的是」「总的来说」这类机器惯用语揪出来改掉。不在清单里的句子原样放行，不重排段落。
skills.tagline_en: Post-draft pass that catches only whitelisted AI tics like 'it's worth noting'—everything else stays exactly as.
skills.desc_en: 按 SKILL.md 明确列出的规则识别并改写写作中的 AI 痕迹。只能处理清单内的问题；未命中规则的文字必须原样保留，也不能改变文章框架。适用于写作完成后的成稿清理。 Remove AI writing tells using an explicit whitelist of rules; leaves unmatched text untouched.
skills.why_zh: 靠显式白名单而非模型直觉，改什么由你定死。规则透明可审计，不会自作主张把个人风格也当AI味洗掉。
skills.why_en: Explicit whitelist instead of model vibes—you control exactly what gets edited. Auditable rules won't mistake your personal.
skills.limit_zh: 只处理SKILL.md列出的规则；未命中文字原样保留。不识别清单外的AI痕迹，也不动文章框架。适合成稿清理。
skills.limit_en: Only edits patterns listed in SKILL.md; unmatched text stays untouched. Won't catch off-list tells or restructure content. For final-pass cleanup.
skills.title_en: Removes only whitelisted AI tells, leaves the rest untouched

skills.name: tenstorrent
skills.title_zh: 跳过网页控制台，直接调 Tenstorrent 全家
skills.tagline_zh: 聊天、画图、视频、TTS、STT 一个 Skill 全包。不用开浏览器、不用记 API 文档。
skills.tagline_en: Skip the web UI. Trigger chat, image, video, TTS, STT from your terminal with a single skill. No browser, no API.
skills.desc_en: Use Tenstorrent console.tenstorrent.com models across chat, image, video, TTS, and STT. Triggers: tenstorrent, 텐스토렌트, Torendissi, 토렌디시, Wan2.2, T2V, text-to-video, image jobs, SDXL, tt-sd3.5, tt-z-image-turbo, DeepSeek-R1, Qwen3, tts-1, whisper-large-v3.
skills.why_zh: 把 console.tenstorrent.com 的模型全收进一个触发词，连 Wan2.2。
skills.why_en: Packs the entire console.tenstorrent.com model lineup behind one trigger word—Wan2.2, SDXL, DeepSeek-R1 included. Feels like.
skills.limit_zh: 需要 Tenstorrent 账号和有效 API 密钥；只覆盖 console.tenstorrent.com 上架模。
skills.limit_en: Requires Tenstorrent account & API key. Covers only console.tenstorrent.com models, not local/third-party. Remote quota limits apply.
skills.title_en: One command to reach all Tenstorrent console models: chat.

skills.name: lieflat-charts
skills.title_zh: 图表先问数据语义再选色，报告模板十二套
skills.tagline_zh: 从真实图表库实现生成 HTML，不靠截图或手写。十二套中英整页报告模板，地图只在你要时才启用，色系不混搭。
skills.tagline_en: Real chart implementations, not screenshots. 12 full-page report templates in CN/EN. Maps only on request.
skills.desc_en: 一套模板驱动的数据可视化与报告生成 skill，既能严格从 Lupi、Basics、Glance、Maps 与 Interactive gallery 的真实实现生成 HTML 图表，也能从 12 套中英文整页报告模板生成可发布的 HTML 报告；以 Mono 为保底，能按数据语义自动选择内置彩色预设，也支持用户明确提供的自定义色板。地图仅在用户明确要求时启用，同一交付禁止混用色系。
skills.why_zh: 以 Mono 为保底，按数据语义自动挑彩色预设，也可用你给的色板——但同一份交付绝不混色系。
skills.why_en: Mono as fallback, semantic auto-palette, custom swatches allowed—but never mixed in one deliverable, so reports look art-directed.
skills.limit_zh: 只认 Lupi/Basics/Glance/Maps/Interactive 五类图表实现；地图必须显式点名才启用。
skills.limit_en: Only Lupi/Basics/Glance/Maps/Interactive chart types. Maps need explicit opt-in. 12 fixed report templates; beyond that, extend yourself.
skills.title_en: Charts that pick palettes by data semantics, 12 report.

skills.name: competitor-gap
skills.title_zh: 专挖对手有而你没有的搜索词，按流量和可赢性排好序
skills.tagline_zh: 别再猜对手凭什么排你前面。输入对方域名，直接列出你缺哪些词、每个词能带来多少流量、值不值得抢。附可赢性评分。
skills.tagline_en: Stop guessing why they outrank you. Enter a competitor domain, get the exact keywords you're missing, ranked by.
skills.desc_en: Find keywords a competitor ranks for that the user's site doesn't — the content gap, prioritized by volume and winnability. Use when asked "what does competitor.com rank for", "keyword gap vs X", "steal competitor keywords", or "why do they outrank us".
skills.why_zh: 不是简单差集。它把每个缺口词按搜索量和你的现有排名综合打分，告诉你先抢哪个、哪个抢了也白抢。
skills.why_en: Not just a keyword diff. It scores each gap by search volume and your current rank, telling you which battles to fight first.
skills.limit_zh: 只认公开搜索数据，不覆盖 Google Ads 私有词或长尾意图；需要你已配置搜索 API 密钥。产物是候选词表。
skills.limit_en: Uses public search data only; no private Ads terms or long-tail intent. Requires your own Search API key. Output is a keyword list, not content or.
skills.title_en: Keyword gap vs competitor, sorted by volume & winnability

skills.name: eli5
skills.title_zh: 把任何概念讲成带大图的幼儿园绘本
skills.tagline_zh: 正文只有一句：「把我当成对这个话题完全不懂的人，用大图、少字的 HTML 页面讲明白。」输出不是一段话，是一页能顺着往下看的图文。
skills.tagline_en: The whole body is one line: explain like I know nothing, as an HTML page with big pictures and few words.
skills.desc_en: The whole body is one line: explain like I know nothing, as an HTML page with big pictures and few words.
skills.why_zh: 它证明 skill 不必复杂：改变的不是信息量，是理解路径——从「读一大段」变成「顺着标题和图往下看」。
skills.why_en: It shows a skill need not be complex — what changes is not the amount of information but the path to understanding.
skills.limit_zh: 整份 SKILL.md 只有一句指令，效果全看你的 agent 会不会做 HTML；不会出图的环境里它就退化成一段普通解释。装的是 anthropics/claude-plugins-community 这个 31 件合集里的一个路径。
skills.limit_en: One sentence; the result depends entirely on whether your agent can render HTML. Installed as one path inside a 31-skill community plugin repo.
skills.title_en: Explain anything as a big-picture HTML page for a total.

skills.name: window-scenery
skills.title_zh: 左下角永远钉着地名徽章的车窗风景照
skills.tagline_zh: 坐在车里想发朋友圈，却总拍出反光玻璃和脏边框？它直接生成从车窗望出去的写实风景，每张左下角自动盖好地名徽章。
skills.tagline_en: Tired of glare and dirty frames in your car-window shots? It renders photorealistic views from any vehicle, each.
skills.desc_en: Generate photorealistic travel images from inside vehicles looking out through windows, with a consistent lower-left location badge. Use when the user asks for "车窗里的风景", "车窗美景", window-view scenery, travel photos from a car/train/boat/plane/cable-car window, or batch image prompts for locations viewed from transportation.
skills.why_zh: 不是简单贴图，而是把车窗框、玻璃反光和窗外景深一起算出来，徽章位置固定，批量出图时风格统一得像同一台相。
skills.why_en: It composites frame, glass reflections, and depth in one pass, with a fixed badge spot—so batch outputs look shot on the same.
skills.limit_zh: 只认交通工具窗景（车/船/飞机/缆车），不生成窗外特写或人像；地名徽章仅限左下角，不能改位置；要真实地名需自备列表。
skills.limit_en: Only vehicle-window scenery (car/boat/plane/cable car); no close-ups or people. Badge stays bottom-left. Real place names need your list—else it.
skills.title_en: Window-view travel shots with a pinned location badge

skills.name: yueyuan
skills.title_zh: 先立假设再找证据的子平八字推演台
skills.tagline_zh: 不信一眼断命。它把《渊海子平》到《穷通宝鉴》拆成可复核的规则层，每步留证据、标不确定度，盲派交叉验证后才给结论。
skills.tagline_en: No snap judgments. It layers Ziping classics into auditable rules, grades evidence A–E, cross-checks with Blind.
skills.desc_en: 【专业子平八字分析系统】融合《渊海子平》《子平真诠》《滴天髓》《穷通宝鉴》正统子平体系与盲派交叉验证的专业命盘分析。核心特色：研究型流程（假设-证据-反证）、规则分层与冲突裁决（STRUCTURAL>CORE>SCHOOL>HEURISTIC>SUPPLEMENTAL）、证据分级 A-E、预注册预测与两阶段盲验证、竞争假设与不确定度、用神六维一致性检查、多流派合议。覆盖：排盘校验、旺衰判断（人元司令分野）、八格格局成败与相神、病药论、调候、十神断法、六亲、干支作用、空亡神煞、大运流年分析顺序、应期断法、婚恋/事业/财富/身心分领域分析。触发词：八字、四柱、排盘、命理、喜用神、格局、旺衰、调候、大运流年、应期、合婚、子平、盲派、十神。
skills.why_zh: 别的 skill 给结论，它给裁决链。规则分五级、冲突有优先级，用神过六维检查才放行——像审稿人。
skills.why_en: Others give answers; this one shows rulings. Five rule tiers with conflict arbitration, six-dimensional Yong Shen checks—a peer.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆盖子平体系与盲派交叉验证，不碰紫微斗数、奇门遁甲。需用户提供公历出生时间与地点；无准确时辰则旺衰。
skills.limit_en: Ziping + Blind School only; no Ziwei or Qimen. Needs exact birth time & place; without it, strength and pattern verdicts downgrade to 'uncertain'.
skills.title_en: Ziping Bazi analysis that pre-registers hypotheses

skills.name: stamp-edge
skills.title_zh: 原图四周直接打半圆孔，真透明背景的邮票生成器
skills.tagline_zh: 不用抠图、不用白边，孔洞处 alpha 全零，拖到深色海报上也干净。多张还能自动拼成等宽瀑布流邮票合集。
skills.tagline_en: No white border, no cutout—holes are truly transparent, stack on any dark background. Batch multiple into a clean.
skills.desc_en: 把任意图片处理成邮票风格——直接在原图四周边缘打半圆锯齿孔洞 + 柔和投影,默认无白边、输出真透明背景 PNG(锯齿孔洞和四周 alpha=0),可直接叠加到任何背景;可选加白色纸边;还能把多张邮票拼成等宽列瀑布流合集图(stamp sheet)。当用户提到"邮票边"、"邮票风格"、"邮票质感"、"锯齿边"、"打孔边"、"perforated edge"、"stamp style"、"postage stamp"、"邮票合集"、"邮票排版"、"stamp sheet",或要求把截图/帖子/图片做成邮票效果时使用。
skills.why_zh: 孔洞不是画上去的白色模拟，而是 alpha=0 的真透明；投影柔和且只在孔洞外缘，叠深色底不露灰块。
skills.why_en: Perforations are true alpha-zero cutouts, not white paint; soft shadow stays outside the holes. No border by default, optional.
skills.limit_zh: 只处理位图（PNG/JPG/WebP），不认 SVG/PDF；输出固定 300 DPI 的 PNG。
skills.limit_en: Raster only (PNG/JPG/WebP); no SVG/PDF. Outputs fixed 300-DPI PNG, drops EXIF. Sheet mode forces equal width—tall images get center-cropped.
skills.title_en: Stamp maker: real transparent PNG with die-cut edge

skills.name: itr-wala
skills.title_zh: 旧新税制并排算完再决定报哪套的印度报税员
skills.tagline_zh: 从 Form 16 到新旧税制对比，再到 Zerodha 资本利得，一个技能走完 FY25-26 报税。
skills.tagline_en: From Form 16 to old-vs-new regime, plus Zerodha capital gains—one skill for FY25-26 ITR. No more ten tabs for 80C.
skills.desc_en: File Indian income tax returns (ITR) for FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27. Use when the user wants to file their ITR, compute or verify Indian income tax, compare the old vs new tax regime, read a Form 16, AIS, TIS or Form 26AS, reconcile TDS, handle capital gains from Zerodha/Groww/Upstox statements, check their tax refund, or asks about ITR-1/ITR-2/ITR-3/ITR-4, sections 80C/80D/87A/111A/112A, crypto tax,
skills.why_zh: 它把 AIS/TIS/26AS 的 TDS 对账和资本利得解析做成了同一套数据流。
skills.why_en: It wires TDS reconciliation from AIS/26AS and capital-gains parsing into one data flow—not separate prompts. Tax is computed.
skills.limit_zh: 只认 FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27，且仅覆盖 ITR-1/2/3/4。不处理公司税、GST。
skills.limit_en: FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27 only, ITR-1/2/3/4. No corporate tax, GST, or non-resident filing; prior-year or foreign-income inputs cause a hard stop, not.
skills.title_en: Indian tax filer that computes old vs new regime.

skills.name: cumcm-step-review
skills.title_zh: 每步先交方案再写代码的国赛建模流水线
skills.tagline_zh: 建模题不再闷头冲：每问先给候选思路，你点头才写代码，每段结果自动落成论文草稿，再审完再走下一步。
skills.tagline_en: No more blind rushes: each subproblem offers candidate plans, waits for your OK, codes, then drafts that section.

skills.why_zh: 把「审核」做成流程关卡而非事后检查——思路、代码、论文三段各自设卡，逼你在写代码前就想清算法。
skills.why_en: Turns review into a gate, not an afterthought: plan, code, and paper each have checkpoints, forcing algorithmic clarity before.
skills.limit_zh: 只服务国赛真题或完整建模流程，不接单问速解；要求你逐段审核，急性子会嫌慢。

skills.name: source-reading

skills.tagline_en: Reads huge unfamiliar repos with AI, outputs books/courses/docs. Zero hallucination: citations byte-verified.
skills.desc_en: 带 AI 精读大型开源仓库，产出每句话都能回溯到源码具体行的书稿、课程或技术文档。核心是零幻觉：每一处引用逐字节核实、行号实读、静默删行由脚本抓出。覆盖锁版本锚点、写逐章大纲、八段结构写章节、编成带封面封底的 HTML 书、机器校验、并行子 Agent 生产六件事。当用户要读懂一个陌生的大型仓库、精读某个开源项目源码、把源码整理成一本书、整理成课程或系列文章、做源码解读、写架构分析、或者要派多个 Agent 并行写技术内容时使用。触发词：精读源码、读源码、源码解读、源码分析、拆解这个项目、这个仓库怎么读、把源码写成课、把源码写成书、写源码精读、架构分析、code walkthrough、带我读代码。
skills.why_zh: 别的工具给你总结，它给你证据链。锁版本锚点+机器校验+并行子Agent。
skills.why_en: Others summarize; it gives you an evidence chain. Version-pinned anchors + machine checks + parallel sub-agents let readers.
skills.limit_zh: 只服务「读懂+产出」闭环：需已有可编译/可解析的源码树，且产出限于书稿/课程/文档，不生成可运行补丁或重构建议。
skills.limit_en: Only for the read-and-produce loop: needs a compilable/parsable source tree; outputs only manuscripts/courses/docs, not runnable patches or.
skills.title_en: Source deep-reader: every claim traceable to a line number

skills.name: dnr-flat-pic
skills.title_zh: 不描边不追光影，只留身份与空间关系的扁平化压缩
skills.tagline_zh: 不是描边转矢量，是语义压缩：保留身份和空间关系，去掉渐变、光晕、纹理、文字和 logo，复杂度压到 6/10 以下。
skills.tagline_en: Semantic compression, not tracing: keep identity and spatial relations, remove gradients, glow, texture, text and logos, cap complexity at 6/10.
skills.desc_en: Semantic compression, not tracing: keep identity and spatial relations, remove gradients, glow, texture, text and logos, cap complexity at 6/10.
skills.why_zh: 它把「简化」定义成可核对的规则——固定 HSB 实色、硬边界、无光效，所以一批图能保持同一套语言。
skills.why_en: It defines simplification as checkable rules — fixed-HSB solid fills, crisp edges, no light effects — so a set stays in one language.
skills.limit_zh: 默认复杂度 6/10 以下，细节多的照片会被大幅删减，想保留纹理或渐变的别装。它删文字、数字、UI 元素是硬规则，带字的海报会被清空。
skills.limit_en: Detail-heavy photos get heavily cut; text, numbers and UI are removed as a hard rule.
skills.title_en: Flatten by semantics, not tracing: keep identity, drop.

skills.name: arch-kele-structure-photo
skills.title_zh: 每张照片出两张图：一张结构研究稿，一张带原图角标
skills.tagline_zh: 一张照片出两张：一张干净的结构研究水彩，一张右上角嵌着原片对照。暖纸底、分析线、克制的标注，配色从照片里取。
skills.tagline_en: Two outputs per photo: a clean structural-study artwork, and one with the untouched source inset top-right. Warm paper, construction lines, restrained labels, palette derived from the photo.
skills.desc_en: Two outputs per photo: a clean structural-study artwork, and one with the untouched source inset top-right. Warm paper, construction lines, restrained labels, palette derived from the photo.
skills.why_zh: 它要求几何仍可辨认——建筑、物件、人、动植物、街景都按同一套方法拆，不是套一层水彩滤镜。
skills.why_en: Geometry must stay recognizable — architecture, objects, people, plants, streetscapes all follow one method; it is not a watercolor filter.
skills.limit_zh: 附带的示例只准用来校准风格，不准影响主体和配色——作者写死了这条。人像和动物也走同一方法，但识别度靠几何保留，不靠五官。只出图，不出可编辑源文件。
skills.limit_en: Bundled examples are for style calibration only, never subject or palette. Image output only.
skills.title_en: Two prints per photo: study sheet + source-inset plate

skills.name: cn-aigc-detector
skills.title_zh: 五维统计信号，专挑中文AI腔的段落级检测器
skills.tagline_zh: 句长方差、词汇TTR、结构模板、句首雷同、标点密度——五个信号交叉验证，高亮可疑段落，不靠猜。
skills.tagline_en: Sentence-length variance, TTR, structural templates, starter uniformity, punctuation density—cross-checked to.
skills.desc_en: Detect AI-generated Chinese text using 5 statistical signals: sentence length variance (perplexity), vocabulary TTR (burstiness), structural pattern matching (首先...其次...最后), sentence starter uniformity, and punctuation density analysis. Highlights suspicious sections. Use when: verifying if Chinese text is AI-generated, checking content authenticity before publishing, auditing user-generated conte
skills.why_zh: 不是给整篇打分，而是逐段定位信号重叠区。把「AI味」拆成可计算的统计特征，让机器腔无处遁形。
skills.why_en: Instead of a whole-text score, it localizes where signals overlap per paragraph. Decomposes 'AI flavor' into computable stats.
skills.limit_zh: 只针对简体中文文本，且需≥200字才有统计意义。不识别翻译腔、混合语言或刻意模仿人类风格的AI改写。输出为高亮段落。
skills.limit_en: Simplified Chinese only, ≥200 chars for significance. Misses translated or humanized AI text. Outputs highlights, not verdicts.
skills.title_en: 5-signal statistical detector for AI-flavored Chinese.

skills.name: youtube-clipper
skills.title_zh: YouTube 长视频先切章再剪段，字幕同步烧进画面
skills.tagline_zh: 你刷到一条 40 分钟访谈，只想留 3 分钟金句。它自动下载、按分钟切章节，你点选片段，字幕翻译、烧录。
skills.tagline_en: Got a 40-min interview but only want the 3-min gold? It auto-downloads, chapterizes by minute, then you.
skills.desc_en: YouTube 视频智能剪辑工具。下载视频和字幕，AI 分析生成精细章节（几分钟级别）， 用户选择片段后自动剪辑、翻译字幕为中英双语、烧录字幕到视频，并生成总结文案。 使用场景：当用户需要剪辑 YouTube 视频、生成短视频片段、制作双语字幕版本时。 关键词：视频剪辑、YouTube、字幕翻译、双语字幕、视频下载、clip video
skills.why_zh: 章节粒度到分钟级，不是粗切；字幕翻译和烧录在同一流水线里完成，不用你导出后再找工具二次加工。选完片段。
skills.why_en: Chapter granularity is minute-level, not coarse cuts; subtitle translation and burn-in happen in one pipeline—no exporting and.
skills.limit_zh: 只吃 YouTube 链接，需能访问 YouTube；依赖 ffmpeg 和 yt-dlp 预装。
skills.limit_en: YouTube links only, needs network access to YouTube; requires ffmpeg & yt-dlp preinstalled. Translation needs source subtitles; no subs means.
skills.title_en: Clip YouTube by chapter, burn bilingual subs in

skills.name: ayi-nonviolent-communication
skills.title_zh: 把指责翻译成需要的长颈鹿语言翻译官
skills.tagline_zh: 吵架前、回消息前、做决定前，先过一遍这架翻译机。它不教你说漂亮话，而是把指责、委屈、纠结拆回普世需要，让话能落地。
skills.tagline_en: Before you snap back, text back, or decide—run it through this translator. It doesn't polish words; it unpacks.
skills.desc_en: 马歇尔·卢森堡《非暴力沟通》(NVC/善意沟通/长颈鹿语言) 的可执行工具箱。核心引擎是把任何信息(自己的或他人的)翻译成"观察—感受—需要—请求" (Observation-Feeling-Need-Request) 四要素,重新与普世"需要"连结。覆盖五类用法:① 决策/自我教练(理清自己的需要再行动); ② 话术改写(把指责/评判式表达改成 NVC 表达); ③ 同理倾听(听见对方话语背后的感受和需要); ④ 冲突调解/复盘(区分需要vs策略,设计满足各方的方案); ⑤ 以马歇尔的语气产出内容。当用户要"帮我想想怎么说/这话该怎么回""我该不该做这个决定/理一理我现在的情绪""改一下这条消息别那么冲" "他这么说我该怎么回应/怎么劝""化解一段冲突/调解吵架/复盘一次难谈话""表达感谢/反馈/批评""我好生气/好委屈/好内疚怎么办", 或提到 非暴力沟通 / NVC / 善意沟通 /
skills.why_zh: 不是话术模板库，而是一台可执行的翻译引擎：输入任何带情绪的原话，输出结构化的四要素。
skills.why_en: Not a phrasebook—an executable engine. Feed it any emotionally loaded line; it returns structured OFNR and separates needs from.
skills.limit_zh: 只处理语言层面的重构，不替代心理咨询或危机干预。若对方处于严重心理危机或双方有暴力史，它不会判断安全边界。
skills.limit_en: Language reframing only; not a substitute for therapy or crisis intervention. In cases of severe distress or violence history, it won't assess.
skills.title_en: NVC translator: turns blame into needs

skills.name: app-ui-ux-best-practices
skills.title_zh: 先拒写设计稿，拿产品证据校准五个刻度再出规范
skills.tagline_zh: 先从产品证据推出五个档位（响度/成色/密度/重量/严肃度），再出设计规范、token、组件准则——每个档位都要给出处，不许凭习惯设。
skills.tagline_en: Derives five register dials from product evidence first, then emits design specs, tokens and component rules — every dial value must cite evidence.
skills.desc_en: Derives five register dials from product evidence first, then emits design specs, tokens and component rules — every dial value must cite evidence.
skills.why_zh: 它有一条含糊词防火墙：premium、精致、克制、高级感一律不许当理由，必须换算成饱和度、间距、圆角、动效幅度。
skills.why_en: A vague-word firewall: premium, refined, elegant, tasteful are never justifications; they must become saturation, spacing, radius and motion numbers.
skills.limit_zh: 它出的是设计规范和单页预览，不是整套前端工程。档位一旦从证据推定，后面所有步骤都跟着走，你想中途换风格得从证据改起。只有一件 skill，正文很长、很吃上下文。
skills.limit_en: Outputs design specs and a single preview page, not a full front-end. Long document, context-hungry. One skill only.
skills.title_en: Evidence-first design specs: calibrate 5 dials before.

skills.name: ResumeSkills
skills.title_zh: 只改动词和数字就过筛的简历润色师
skills.tagline_zh: 投了 50 份没回音？不是你不配，是简历没撞对 ATS 的钟。这套技能把求职拆成可执行的每一步。
skills.tagline_en: 50 applications, zero callbacks? It's not you—it's your resume missing ATS keywords. This suite turns job hunting.
skills.desc_en: A collection of AI agent skills focused on resume optimization, job applications, and career development. Built for job seekers, career changers, and professionals who want Claude Code to help with resume writing, ATS optimization, interview prep, and strategic job search.
skills.why_zh: 不是单个提示词，而是按求职流程分模块的技能集合：简历重写、ATS 扫描、面试模拟各司其职。
skills.why_en: Not one mega-prompt—a modular pipeline. Rewrite, ATS-scan, and interview-prep skills each do one job, callable solo or chained.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆盖求职文本与面试话术，不生成职位匹配度报告，也不替你做薪资谈判。需要你已有目标 JD 或简历原文。
skills.limit_en: Covers resume text & interview scripts only—no job-match scoring, no salary negotiation. Needs a target JD or existing resume; vague verbal input.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

skills.title_en: Resume editor that fixes verbs & numbers to pass ATS filters

skills.name: goldie
skills.title_zh: 重放 App 操作录屏，套上真实商店页边框和文案
skills.tagline_zh: 回放 argent 流程录屏，给截图套机身边框、配底色和文案，出 4~5 张成品加一段预览视频，本地起个 studio 按真实商店页排给你看。
skills.tagline_en: Replays argent flows, frames the captures with a device bezel, background and copy, and opens a local studio laid out as the real store page.
skills.desc_en: Replays argent flows, frames the captures with a device bezel, background and copy, and opens a local studio laid out as the real store page.
skills.why_zh: 预览视频它坚持交原始录屏不加边框字幕——因为苹果就是这么要求的，它没替你「美化」成会被打回的东西。
skills.why_en: It insists the preview video stays a plain screen recording — because Apple requires that — instead of prettifying it into something that gets rejected.
skills.limit_zh: 要在这个 App 自己的仓里跑，且要有 iOS 模拟器或安卓模拟器。挑哪几屏值得营销、写流程、写文案还是你的活，它只负责跑和渲。studio 起在 localhost:4321，视频在后台渲。
skills.limit_en: Run it from the mobile app's own repo with a simulator available. Choosing which screens to market, authoring the flows and writing the copy stay yours.
skills.title_en: Replay app flows, framed in a real store page mockup

skills.name: aicss
skills.title_zh: AI 对话界面不重造轮子，现成思考态与流式输出组件
skills.tagline_zh: 思考中、流式输出这类 AI 会话专用的界面部件，npm 装 React 版，或用 CLI 取 React／Vue／Svelte 源码直接落进你的项目。
skills.tagline_en: Thinking states, streaming output and other AI-conversation UI pieces — npm for React, or pull React/Vue/Svelte source straight into your project via CLI.
skills.desc_en: Thinking states, streaming output and other AI-conversation UI pieces — npm for React, or pull React/Vue/Svelte source straight into your project via CLI.
skills.why_zh: AI 产品的界面反复要造同一批零件，这里把它们做成了能直接取走的成品，还带在线预览。
skills.why_en: Every AI product rebuilds the same handful of chat-UI parts; these are finished, with live previews.
skills.limit_zh: 它不是 SKILL.md 形态的 agent skill，装不进 agent，是 npm 包和 CLI，要你自己写代码接。免费组件在 npm 上；Pro 组件不在，要用 CLI 配 AICSS_TOKEN，那是付费的。文档站是闭源的，这个仓只是包源码。
skills.limit_en: Not a SKILL.md agent skill — an npm package and CLI you wire up yourself. Free components on npm; Pro ones need a paid AICSS_TOKEN.
skills.title_en: AI chat UI parts: thinking states & streaming output, no.

skills.name: photo-chromatic-abstraction-style-1
skills.title_zh: 只留 1~5 个源图色，把照片译成色块记忆卡
skills.tagline_zh: 照片信息太多？它只留色块和1-5个克制的高光点。适合色彩构成练习、色卡转译，或你只想记住画面的颜色而非细节时。
skills.tagline_en: Too much detail in your photo? It keeps only flat color fields plus 1-5 restrained accents. For palette-memory.
skills.desc_en: Translate an uploaded or local photograph into a color-first chromatic-memory abstraction (Style 1) built from adaptive flat fields and 1-5 restrained, source-derived accents. Use for palette-memory composition, color-weight studies, minimalist color-block translation, 色块抽象、照片色彩记忆、色彩构成、照片色卡转译，or explicit Style-1 requests where broad color hierarchy matters more than subject placement. Do not use w
skills.why_zh: 自适应平场分区，不靠边缘检测或主体识别——颜色层级决定一切，高光点从原图推导而非随机点缀。
skills.why_en: Adaptive flat-field segmentation, not edge detection or subject recognition—color hierarchy drives everything. Accents are.
skills.limit_zh: 只做风格1的色块抽象，不做构图重构或细节保留。输入需为单张照片（本地或上传），不支持多图合成。产物为静态图。
skills.limit_en: Only Style-1 color-block abstraction; no composition reshaping or detail retention. Single photo input only (local or upload), no multi-image.
skills.title_en: Photo to 1–5-color memory blocks, not a copy

skills.name: personal-reflector
skills.title_zh: 不喂鸡汤只拆模式的自我复盘镜
skills.tagline_zh: 当焦虑、自我怀疑、关系困局反复出现，它不给你鸡汤，而是帮你照见旧系统如何运作、新系统卡在哪，让转型期不再原地打转。
skills.tagline_en: When anxiety, self-doubt, or relationship loops repeat, it skips the platitudes—showing how your old system runs.
skills.desc_en: Use when the user discusses personal emotions, anxiety, self-doubt, behavior patterns, relationships, career identity confusion, or life direction. Triggers on: 焦虑、难受、怀疑自己、模式、重复、关系、职业身份、方向迷茫、转型期、恢复期、意义感、新旧系统交替。
skills.why_zh: 它不分析你，而是镜像你——把情绪事件拆成可观察的模式与触发点，像一面会提问的镜子。
skills.why_en: It doesn't analyze you—it mirrors you, breaking emotional events into observable patterns and triggers, like a mirror that asks.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆盖个人内心议题（情绪、身份、方向），不处理外部决策或人际冲突的具体解法；产物是结构化反思而非行动方案。
skills.limit_en: Only covers inner issues (emotions, identity, direction), not external decisions or conflict solutions; output is structured reflection, not action.
skills.title_en: A self-reflection mirror that dissects patterns, not.

skills.name: threejs-animation
skills.title_zh: 骨骼、变形、混合全包，GLTF 动画直接上手
skills.tagline_zh: 骨骼、变形、关键帧、混合，GLTF 动画拿来即播。写代码前先问它，省得自己翻文档拼 API。
skills.tagline_en: Keyframe, skeletal, morph, and mixing—play GLTF animations instantly. Ask before coding to skip API doc digging.
skills.desc_en: Three.js animation - keyframe animation, skeletal animation, morph targets, animation mixing. Use when animating objects, playing GLTF animations, creating procedural motion, or blending animations.
skills.why_zh: 它把官方示例拆成可复用的动作片段，按语义调用而非抄代码。你描述意图，它给出对应实现。
skills.why_en: It turns official examples into reusable action snippets, invoked by intent rather than copy-paste. Describe what you want, get.
skills.limit_zh: 仅覆盖 Three.js 动画模块，不含场景搭建、模型加载或渲染优化。超出此范围需自行处理，且要求环境已安装 Thre。
skills.limit_en: Covers only Three.js animation APIs. No scene setup, model loading, or render optimization. Requires Three.js installed and GLTF assets present.
skills.title_en: Keyframe, skeletal, morph, mixing—GLTF animation ready

skills.name: vibe-techdesign
skills.title_zh: 先写技术设计再写代码，让 MVP 不返工
skills.tagline_zh: 当你纠结“该用什么栈、怎么搭”时，它不替你做决定，而是把选项、权衡、风险摊成一张表，让讨论有锚点、决策有痕迹。
skills.tagline_en: Stuck on stack or structure? It won't decide for you—it lays out options, trade-offs, and risks as a table, so.
skills.desc_en: Create a Technical Design Document for your MVP. Use when the user wants to plan architecture, choose tech stack, or says "plan technical design", "choose tech stack", or "how should I build this".
skills.why_zh: 它把散落的“我觉得”逼成“因为…所以…”，用模板强制你写清约束、备选与放弃理由，让技术评审从拍脑袋变成。
skills.why_en: It forces scattered opinions into 'because… therefore…' by templating constraints, alternatives, and rejections—turning gut-feel.
skills.limit_zh: 只产出文档，不写代码、不跑验证。若你已确定技术栈且无评审需求，或团队习惯口头决策，它只会增加文书负担。
skills.limit_en: Outputs a doc only—no code, no validation. If stack is fixed and no review is needed, or your team decides verbally, it's just extra paperwork.
skills.title_en: Write the tech design first, so your MVP survives

skills.name: tastemaker
skills.title_zh: 看一眼参考图就生成同气质界面的设计手
skills.tagline_zh: 你贴一张Dribbble/Pinterest图，它提取配色、字体、圆角、间距，直接产出同风格界面。
skills.tagline_en: Paste a Dribbble/Pinterest shot, it extracts colors, fonts, radii, spacing, and builds UI that matches. No more.
skills.desc_en: Generate genuinely beautiful, on-brand UI instead of generic "AI slop" — use whenever the user asks to build, design, style, or improve a UI, landing page, dashboard, app screen, or component, whenever a PRD/spec needs a design pass before implementation, whenever the user pastes reference images/Pinterest/Dribbble links and wants the app to look like them, or whenever the user complains the AI-ge
skills.why_zh: 它先解析参考图的视觉语言，再套用你的组件库，而不是凭空生成。风格迁移有结构，不是滤镜糊上去。
skills.why_en: It parses the visual language of your reference, then applies it to your component library—structured style transfer, not a.
skills.limit_zh: 只认静态参考图，不认Figma文件或设计token；产物是前端代码，不负责导出设计稿；若参考图是插画/3D渲染。
skills.limit_en: Only static images, not Figma files or design tokens; outputs frontend code, not design specs; for illustrations/3D renders, it only extracts.
skills.title_en: A UI stylist that matches the vibe of your reference image
skills.cover_note: 仓即产品，仓级图就是这件的图

skills.name: a2ui-renderer
skills.title_zh: A2UI 界面渲染器，装上就能让 Agent 画表单
skills.tagline_zh: 你的 Agent 开始返回 JSON 界面描述，但前端还停在纯文本聊天？这个 skill 让 A2UI 声明自动变。
skills.tagline_en: Agent returns JSON UI specs but your frontend still shows plain text? This skill turns A2UI declarations into.
skills.desc_en: Render A2UI (Agent-to-UI declarative surfaces) in CopilotKit v2. Enable the runtime via CopilotRuntime({ a2ui: {...} }), then enable the provider via <CopilotKit a2ui={{ theme }}>. Auto-activates via /info — do NOT manually pass renderActivityMessages. createA2UIMessageRenderer ships from @copilotkit/react-core/v2; low-level primitives (A2UIProvider, A2UIRenderer, createCatalog) ship from @copilot
skills.why_zh: 它把渲染管线拆成两层：运行时负责激活，provider 负责主题，底层原语（Provider/Rend。
skills.why_en: Splits rendering into runtime activation + themed provider, with low-level primitives (Provider/Renderer/catalog) fully exposed.
skills.limit_zh: 只认 CopilotKit v2 的 A2UI 格式；非 A2UI 的 Agent 消息不会渲染。
skills.limit_en: Only CopilotKit v2 A2UI format; non-A2UI messages won't render. Requires @copilotkit/react-core/v2 + runtime. Auto-activation via /info only—manual.

skills.limit_zh: 不是角色设定全集。要三视图、要服装表，另找。

skills.name: novel-characters

skills.limit_en: Requires full novel text (a few chapters min); short stories underperform. Image gen needs built-in $imagegen; otherwise text-only cards. Report is.

skills.why_zh: 日常照片压成杂志里那种抽象编辑页，不是再加一层滤镜。
skills.why_en: The abstract panel's palette and geometry are derived from the source pixels, not random—so it shares a traceable visual lineage.
skills.limit_zh: 要认得出路牌和人脸，会抽空。要纪录完整现场，别装。
skills.limit_en: Single vertical photo only; output is a diptych, no collages. Abstraction extracts color and tone only, no semantic recognition (faces/objects).
skills.title_en: Turn one photo into a restrained editorial diptych

skills.name: poetic-line-zine-poster
skills.title_zh: 上半原片，下半抽成线
skills.tagline_zh: 竖版照片加抽象，像一本薄刊物的一页
skills.tagline_en: Portrait, street, pet, building—keep the photo, sweep its relationships into charcoal, add one structural.
skills.desc_en: Create a clean vertical photo-and-abstraction editorial artwork from an uploaded portrait, travel photo, animal, plant, architecture, object, or scene. Preserve the source photo, distill its relationships into broad charcoal sweeps and one structural chromatic scribble, add restrained experimental English typography, and deliver an exact requested aspect ratio through deterministic composition and
skills.why_zh: 上面保住照片，下面用线重新说一遍。
skills.why_en: Not a filter stack—it decomposes the photo into relationships, redraws with charcoal for mood and one scribble for structure.
skills.limit_zh: 页是竖的编辑页，不是横版大片，也不是九宫格。
skills.limit_en: Single clear-subject photo only, no blown highlights; serif English type only, no Chinese; static PNG output, no multipage or motion; deterministic.
skills.title_en: Turn one photo into a poetic editorial poster

skills.name: xianxia-visual-director
skills.title_zh: 仙侠静帧导演
skills.tagline_zh: 画仙侠总像贴图堆砌？这套 canon 固定五层空间、40–60% 留白呼吸感，让建筑悬空无栏杆、仙人衣袂自带风。
skills.tagline_en: Tired of flat xianxia art? Fixed 5-layer space, 40–60% breathing air, railing-free floating architecture, robes.
skills.desc_en: Generate, derive, optimize, and diagnose structured AI image prompts for luminous cinematic Eastern xianxia environments under one inherited master canon with measurable divine scale, fixed five-layer space, 40–60% content-bearing breathing air, monumental Eastern architecture, railing-free edges, and coherent immortals and costume. Cover one-location scenic landmarks, immense inhabited celestial
skills.why_zh: 天宫、巨构、东方玄幻静帧，一种世界观拍到底，不是通用绘本。
skills.why_en: Not random style roulette—one inherited canon with measurable divine scale, fixed depth layers, and enforced breathing-air.
skills.limit_zh: 现代都市、写实人像、科幻硬表面会串味。它只导仙侠这一场。
skills.limit_en: Static xianxia environments & costumes only—no action, combat, or multi-shot narrative. Outputs structured prompt text, not images; bring your own.
skills.title_en: Turn xianxia scenes into breathing cinematic Eastern wonders

skills.name: photo-to-travel-sketch
skills.title_zh: 旅行照片收成赶路速写
skills.tagline_zh: 黑线乱走、大量省略，像纤维笔当场画
skills.tagline_en: Blurry, overexposed, or messy street shots become sketchbook pages with broken ink lines and muted marker.
skills.desc_en: Convert a user-provided photo into a fast, loose observational travel sketch using economical wandering black contours, aggressive omission, dry fiber-tip marker strokes, source-aware but gray-muted color, and naive compressed perspective. Use when the user asks to turn a photo, streetscape, building, landscape, or travel memory into a spontaneous personal sketchbook, urban-sketch, pen-and-marker,
skills.why_zh: 观察式速写，不是精修风景画。走得快，轮廓乱，故意少画。
skills.why_en: It doesn't just filter—it re-draws from scene structure: selective contours, flattened perspective, source-aware desaturated.
skills.limit_zh: 要干净线稿、要上色完成稿，会嫌它脏。
skills.limit_en: Single photo only; no video or multi-image stitching. Output is one static sketch—no animation or 3D. Very dark or heavily blurred input loses.
skills.title_en: Turn any photo into a loose hand-drawn travel sketch

skills.name: xiaoma-durex-copywriter
skills.title_zh: 按杜蕾斯海报那套双关写文案
skills.tagline_zh: 热点来了只会硬蹭？借势海报总像喊口号？这套方法把2011-2017环时互动的双层语义+留白拆成步骤。
skills.tagline_en: Tired of forced hot-topic posts and slogan-y posters? This kit turns Durex's 2011-2017 golden-era double-meaning.
skills.desc_en: 用杜蕾斯黄金期（2011-2017 环时互动）那套「双层语义 + 留白」的方法产出文案与海报。先识别用户意图并给 3-5 个方案供选，再出短文案（长文案可选）+ 五种比例配图。适用于借势热点、节日节气、产品卖点、课程/知识付费推广、自媒体标题与封面、品牌人格化运营。当用户说「写个文案」「借势热点」「节日海报」「想句 slogan」「课程怎么推」「公众号/小红书封面」「像杜蕾斯那样写」「一语双关」时使用。
skills.why_zh: 从 260 张原海报拆出双层语义和视觉公式，不是「写得性感一点」这种空指令。
skills.why_en: No cliché templates. It decodes intent, then branches into double-meaning candidates—turning 'write like Durex' from mystique.
skills.limit_zh: 配方来自避孕套海报。拿去写政务、写药品说明书、写严肃讣告，会很脏。
skills.limit_en: Outputs copy & layout specs only—no design execution or posting. Double-entendre relies on Chinese homophones/ambiguity; fails in other languages.
skills.title_en: Turn Durex-style double entendre into a reusable.

skills.name: dreamy-motion-editorial
skills.title_zh: 日常照片收成雾面编辑稿
skills.tagline_zh: 抽出主角，大留白，像在动的杂志页
skills.tagline_en: Your casual shot lacks mood? It distills the emotional hero, rebuilds it with negative space, soft focus, and.
skills.desc_en: Extract the semantic hero from any casual photo and rebuild it as a premium hazy dreamlike motion-editorial image with large negative space, simplified context, selective preservation, and restrained poster hierarchy. Use when the user provides or references a photo and asks for 高级感、朦胧感、梦幻感、电影感、慢门拖影、柔焦、胶片感、诗意海报、Pinterest 同类氛围、图生图提示词、AI 生图提示词、照片风格改造、帖子视觉、封面图、艺术摄影、青春残影、玻璃倒影、花卉虚焦、逆光晕染, or wants a reu
skills.why_zh: 从随便一张里找出该被看见的那个，重建成带雾的编辑图。
skills.why_en: Not a filter-word pile: it semantically parses the photo, strips context, selectively preserves, then rebuilds with poster.
skills.limit_zh: 现场杂物和背景故事会让路。要纪录完整场景，别装这件。
skills.limit_en: Single still photo only; outputs prompt text, not images. Requires your own img2img tool (Midjourney/SD). No video, multi-image compositing, or.
skills.title_en: Turn casual photos into hazy poetic poster prompts

skills.name: flat-poster-op
skills.title_zh: 有证据的扁平海报复刻
skills.tagline_zh: 要黄黑白高反差、赭橙西部剪影、黑底动态字体？它给逐镜图像提示词、独立运动/I2V 与负向约束。
skills.tagline_en: High-contrast yellow-black, ochre western silhouettes, kinetic type? It outputs per-shot image prompts, separate.
skills.desc_en: 只生成“纯二维赛璐璐 × 抽象 MG × 动态平面海报”视频的可复制提示词，包括全局风格锁、逐镜图像提示词、独立运动/I2V 提示词、可选标题合成提示词与负向约束。Use when the user asks for 黄黑白高反差、赭橙西部剪影、黑底动态字体、波普分割构图、节拍硬切、定格 pose、电影宣传片或海螺/MiniMax/OpenArt 提示词，尤其是“只输出提示词”“别做其他操作”“prompt only”。本 Skill 不创建文件、不生成或渲染媒体、不调用外部平台，也不附加分析报告。
skills.why_zh: 作者要求对照原作再画，不是凭感觉「扁平化一下」。
skills.why_en: Style lock is a global variable inherited by every shot; motion prompts are decoupled from image prompts so I2V tuning never.
skills.limit_zh: 没有对照图就不要跑。它复刻的是扁平 OP，不是你品牌的新视觉系统。
skills.limit_en: Only covers cel-2D × abstract MG × motion-poster style. No file creation, no rendering, no external API calls. Outside this style or if asked to.
skills.title_en: Distill motion-poster shots into copy-paste prompts

skills.name: as-told-to
skills.title_zh: 只记你说过的话，不替你补半句的人生访谈录
skills.tagline_zh: 一场一场地采访你或你父母的人生，逐字稿原样留档，另出一份下次接着问的笔记；成不成书随你，档案先归你自己。
skills.tagline_en: Interviews you, or your parent, session by session; keeps the verbatim transcript untouched and a separate working note for next time. Whether it becomes a book is your call — the archive is yours either way.
skills.desc_en: A deep life-story interviewer for Claude and Codex — your story, in your words, in plain files you own. Never invents a word of your life. Free, MIT.
skills.why_zh: 不许递一个细节让老人点头确认：「大概 2003 年冬天吧」进待核清单，正文写「我不确定」。
skills.why_en: It will not hand the elder a detail to nod at. "Probably winter 2003" goes on the verify list, and the record itself says "2003 or 2004 — I'm not certain."
skills.limit_zh: 它只采访在场的本人，不替不在场的人写传记，也拒绝改写成简历、领英简介或创始人故事。情绪一上来就全停：只给「留在这里／换话题／今天到这」三个选项，一个追问都不许有。仓库 dev/ 目录里抄了同行的整份 skill 当对照，安装时别一起拷进去。
skills.limit_en: It only interviews the person in the room, refuses to write a biography of someone absent, and declines to convert the corpus into a resume, LinkedIn bio or founder story. When emotion rises it stops entirely, offering only stay here / change the subject / done for today, with no question about what surfaced. The repo's dev/ folder contains other authors' full skills copied in as prior art — don't install that part.
skills.title_en: Life-story interviewer that writes only your words

skills.name: travel-guidebook
skills.title_zh: 从踩点笔记到排版成册，一趟生成旅行指南 PDF
skills.tagline_zh: 把行程调研做成能打印的 PDF 路书：暖色纸底、衬线体、Tabler 图标和内联 SVG 装饰，靠排版撑设计感。
skills.tagline_en: Turns trip research into a printable PDF guidebook — warm parchment ground, serif type, Tabler icons and inline SVG ornament. The design comes from typesetting, not from generated pictures.
skills.desc_en: AI agent skill that generates beautifully typeset travel guidebook PDFs —  from research to print, powered by parallel agents and Amap MCP.
skills.why_zh: 「零 AI 插图」是硬规则不是风格偏好——旅行册子最容易骗人的就是一张不存在的风景图。
skills.why_en: Zero AI illustration is a hard rule rather than a taste preference. The easiest way for a travel book to lie is a landscape photo of a place that does not exist.
skills.limit_zh: 要 Node.js 和 Playwright 才能导 PDF，装环境有成本。深度调研阶段会并行开五个 agent，很吃 token。成品是印刷导向的长文档，不是手机上随时改的行程 App。只做排版和成书，订票订房都不管。
skills.limit_en: Needs Node.js and Playwright to export the PDF. The research stage fans out five parallel agents and burns tokens. The output is a print-oriented document, not a phone itinerary you tweak on the road. It typesets and binds; it books nothing.
skills.title_en: Turn scattered travel notes into a print-ready guidebook PDF
skills.cover_note: 09-03 对账：文件是 64x64，和记录不符且拿不回真图，下卡

skills.name: gc-muted-zine-poster-v0-1
skills.title_zh: 低饱和刊物海报
skills.tagline_zh: 纸感、哑光、一个色彩重音就够
skills.tagline_en: Feed it a theme, sentence, object, or mood; get a muted, large-negative-space poster prompt plus a sample image.
skills.desc_en: Generate Muted Zine Poster v0.1 poetic paper-poster prompts and the matching generated image. Use when the user gives a theme, sentence, object, mood, article idea, photo, or content brief and wants a quiet Japanese/Korean zine-like editorial poster with large negative space, aged paper texture, experimental typography, and a restrained muted palette without high-chroma color blocks. This is the l
skills.why_zh: 主题或句子压成竖版纸感海报，饱和度被按住。
skills.why_en: It operationalizes 'quietness' into concrete specs—paper grain, experimental type, negative space, muted palette—so results feel.
skills.limit_zh: 不是热闹大片。要霓虹、要满版字，对不上。
skills.limit_en: Outputs only a prompt and one sample image, not an editable file. You must render final art elsewhere. No high-chroma or illustration styles.
skills.title_en: Turn a phrase into a quiet zine-style poster prompt and.

skills.name: qiaopi
skills.title_zh: 一句话白话文，落成南洋阿嬷能读的家书
skills.tagline_zh: 把「今天好想你」翻成南洋华侨寄回故乡的家书，抬头、起兴、嘱咐、落款按干支年排好；说话人和对象不明就先沉浸式反问一次。
skills.tagline_en: Turns "I miss you today" into a letter a Nanyang emigrant would have sent home: salutation, seasonal opening, instructions, and a sexagenary-cycle sign-off — asking one question first if it cannot place the writer and reader.
skills.desc_en: 把现代的一句话翻译成侨批体（南洋华侨家书风格）的 skill，致敬电影《给阿嬷的情书》
skills.why_zh: 落款绝不写「妾」；历史上侨批必有钱，但你没提寄钱它就不写附银那行——凭空加一句就跳戏。
skills.why_en: The sign-off may never use the self-deprecating "concubine" form. And although real qiaopi always enclosed money, it leaves that line out unless you asked for it — inventing a remittance breaks the letter.
skills.limit_zh: 只做一种语感：潮汕南洋侨批体，以电影《给阿嬷的情书》的诗化句式为骨，不是通用文言翻译器。随件是 1888–1957 年真实侨批和电影里的信，用来学句式、不是史料库。方言只作点缀，不会写成全篇潮汕话。
skills.limit_en: It does one register — Teochew/Nanyang qiaopi, built on the lyric cadence of the 2026 film Letters to Grandma — not general classical Chinese. The bundled references are real 1888-1957 letters and lines from the film, there to teach phrasing rather than to serve as an archive. Dialect appears as seasoning only; it will not write a whole letter in Teochew.
skills.title_en: Turn plain sentences into Nanyang grandpa-style letters

skills.name: guitar
skills.title_zh: 只给和弦走向、绝不替你抄歌词的吉他谱生成器
skills.tagline_zh: 说一个歌名，它出一份坐下就能弹的谱：和弦图、带小节数的段落结构、前奏 riff 和 solo 的六线谱。
skills.tagline_en: Name a song and it produces a chart you can sit down and play: chord diagrams, an arrangement map with bar counts, tab for the intro riff and the solo, filed into your own repertoire library with an index.
skills.desc_en: A Claude Code skill that turns a song name into an advanced, playable guitar chart
skills.why_zh: 谱里只有和弦走向、不含歌词——它让你自己从有授权的来源补上，并写明这些谱不许转发。
skills.why_en: The chart carries the progression and no lyrics — it tells you to add those from a licensed source yourself, and asks you not to republish the charts.
skills.limit_zh: 冷门曲目它会标 MEDIUM/LOW 置信度，让你自己对着录音核哪几段是猜的。和弦图靠随件 python 脚本渲染成 ASCII，没有五线谱也没有音频。谱固定存到 ~/Documents/Guitar/Songs 下。它给的是「大概是这样」，不是官方谱。
skills.limit_en: For obscure songs it flags MEDIUM or LOW confidence and tells you which parts to check against the recording. Chord diagrams render as ASCII from a bundled python script; there is no staff notation and no audio. Charts always land in ~/Documents/Guitar/Songs. What you get is a careful best reading, not an official transcription.
skills.title_en: The guitar chart builder that will not type out the lyrics

skills.name: sticker-puzzle-memory-card
skills.title_zh: 植被多就换品红键色，把照片做成能剪下来的贴纸页
skills.tagline_zh: 照片做成好看的图不难，难的是拿到一张真能打印、真能剪的透明贴纸。它一次交记忆卡和六枚图案的透明 PNG。
skills.tagline_en: Turning a photo into a pretty image is easy; getting a transparent sheet you can actually print and cut is not. This delivers a memory card and a six-motif transparent PNG together.
skills.desc_en: 将照片转化为水粉剪纸风格旅行记忆卡 + 拼图对比图
skills.why_zh: 去背走色度键，绿场景会撞色，所以植被多的图改用品红打底，最后还要验四角 alpha 是不是 0。
skills.why_en: Background removal runs on a chroma key, and green collides with foliage, so leafy photos are keyed on magenta instead — then all four corner alphas are verified as zero.
skills.limit_zh: 生图模型被写死成 seedream_5.0_pro，接不上这个模型的 agent 装了没用。贴纸恰好六枚、手写关键词恰好三个，都是定死的，不接受你要八枚。原图里的文字只在真的标识了地点时才留，广告、菜单、价格、时间戳一律剔掉。 上游 SKILL.md 的 name 是中文，装上后可能不被识别，改成英文更稳。
skills.limit_en: The image model is hard-wired to one specific generator, so it is dead weight on an agent that cannot reach it. Six stickers and three handwritten keywords are fixed counts; asking for eight is not an option. Text from your photo survives only when it genuinely names a place — ads, menus, prices and timestamps are all stripped. Upstream's name field is Chinese, so the loader may not pick it up — rename it to ASCII.
skills.title_en: Switches the chroma key to magenta when the photo is full of green

skills.name: seedance-2-5-video-director
skills.title_zh: Seedance 2.5 专属导演，分镜脚本一次改到
skills.tagline_zh: 即梦每生成一版都在扣积分，改一次就是一次赌。它只交可复制的提示词，遇到「向前续写」这种歧义必须先问你放在原片前还是后。
skills.tagline_en: Every Dreamina render costs credits, so a vague prompt is a paid mistake. It hands you the director's brief and a copy-ready prompt, and never guesses.
skills.desc_en: Design, derive, optimize, diagnose, and rewrite scripts or copy-ready prompts specifically for Dreamina/即梦 Seedance 2.5. Use for new text/image/video/audio-to-video concepts, exact-timeline videos, 30-180-second Long Video, extension, video editing, Clay Renderer, seamless transitions, multi-grid storyboards, realistic acted dialogue, relationship drama, sports or variety-show live camera grammar,
skills.why_zh: 它把边界写成硬规则：只产文字、不调用生成、不花积分；时间戳必须严丝合缝铺满时长，眼泪和脸红不许出现在触发之前。
skills.why_en: The boundaries are hard rules: text only, no job submission, no credits spent. Timestamps must tile the full duration exactly, and a reaction may not land before its cause.
skills.limit_zh: 它不生成视频，只交提示词——粘回即梦、扣积分、返工仍是你的事。绑死 Seedance 2.5 一个模型，正文明写别把这些语法当成其他视频模型的通用规则。默认中文输出；每个新会话第一次调用会先塞一整段强制教学。
skills.limit_en: It writes prompts, not videos — pasting, paying and re-rolling stay with you. Bound to Seedance 2.5, it says not to treat its syntax as universal across video models. Output defaults to Chinese, and each session's first call opens with a tutorial.
skills.title_en: A director's desk for Seedance 2.5: scripts to shootable.

skills.name: whiteboard-video
skills.title_zh: 线稿只准本地模型抽、不许 AI 生成的白板手绘视频
skills.tagline_zh: 上传一张照片，它先用本地神经网络抽出线稿，再一笔一笔画出来、配一只跟着笔尖走的手。
skills.tagline_en: Hand it a photo and it pulls the line art with a local neural model, then draws it stroke by stroke with a hand trailing the pen tip — instead of asking an image model for something that merely looks hand-drawn.
skills.why_zh: 两个本地模型一个都没装时，它规定必须直接失败 —— 不许用边缘检测糊一版弱线稿交差。
skills.why_en: With neither local model installed it is required to fail outright — no edge-detection fallback, because a weak outline that looks finished is worse than an error.
skills.limit_zh: 它只是适配层：引擎要 pip 装另一个仓库，Informative Drawings 或 Anime2Sketch 至少装一个并设环境变量，而模型的安装指南在引擎仓库里、不在这一件。一个都没装时它直接失败，不给降级方案。
skills.limit_en: It is only an adapter. The engine is a separate pip install, you must set up Informative Drawings or Anime2Sketch yourself and point env vars at it, and the model setup guide lives in the engine repo rather than here. With neither installed, extract-lineart and render-photo fail outright.
skills.title_en: Refuses to let an image model draw the line art
skills.cover_note: 09-03 对账：文件不存在，和记录不符且拿不回真图，下卡

skills.name: boardgame-creator
skills.title_zh: 从灵感草稿到朋友试玩，一张桌游的完整出生证明
skills.tagline_zh: 点子有了，卡在「到底好不好玩」。它先把 6–10 个关键决策一次交底，再逼出一份今天就能手写出来的纸面原型。
skills.tagline_en: You have the idea and you are stuck on whether it actually plays. This states the six to ten decisions that matter up front, then drives you to a paper prototype you could hand-write today.
skills.desc_en: 中文实体桌游创作 Skill：从灵感、纸面原型到试玩迭代与朋友介绍材料
skills.why_zh: 它给自己上了禁令：没经过真人试玩只能说「可试玩」，不能说「平衡」——纸面审查只找风险，不发合格证。
skills.why_en: It bans itself from certain words: with no real playtest it may only say "playable", never "balanced". Paper review finds risks; it does not issue a pass.
skills.limit_zh: 平衡只能靠真人试玩验，所以你得自己凑齐人——它明写纸面审查不能证明平衡。交付物是纸面原型，美术、量产、众筹一概不管，第一版明说不追求出版。多视角批评里连「易感到被针对者」都算上了，但那仍是模拟，不是玩家。不做电子游戏实现。
skills.limit_en: Balance can only be proven at a real table, so you have to find the players yourself; the file says outright that paper review cannot prove balance. What you get is a paper prototype — art, manufacturing and crowdfunding are all out, and the first version deliberately does not aim at publication. Its multi-perspective critique even includes the player who feels picked on, but that is still simulation, not a playtester. No digital implementation.
skills.title_en: A board game's full birth certificate, from spark to.

skills.name: pet-nutritionist
skills.title_zh: 严禁给龙猫洗澡、也给矮脚马算食谱的宠物营养师
skills.tagline_zh: 兔子龙猫严禁水洗、只能沙浴，豚鼠每天得补维生素C，矮脚马每 6–8 周修一次蹄——猫狗之外那些宠物，它才是主场。
skills.tagline_en: Rabbits and chinchillas must never get wet, only sand baths. Guinea pigs need vitamin C daily. A Shetland pony needs its hooves trimmed every six to eight weeks. This one lives outside the cat-and-dog world.
skills.desc_en: 科学铲屎官 - 营养×洗护×零食玩具 | Scientific Pet Care Assistant | TRAE SOLO Skill
skills.why_zh: 它先查物种合法性：蛇、土拨鼠、狐狸一律不服务，理由是《野生动物保护法》，不是不会答。
skills.why_en: It screens the species before anything else — snakes, marmots and foxes get turned away on wildlife-law grounds, not for lack of an answer.
skills.limit_zh: 皮肤问题它一律当病症处理，直接让你去医院，不给洗护调理方案。全部本事是一段提示词加十份参考清单，不带脚本也不带计算器；喂食量要你自己报品种、月龄、体重、体况和绝育状况才算。爬行类和野生动物直接拒答。
skills.limit_en: Skin trouble is always treated as illness and sent to a vet, so there is no home-grooming fix here. The whole thing is one prompt plus ten reference sheets, with no scripts and no calculator, and it will not size a meal until you supply breed, age in months, weight, body condition and neuter status. Reptiles and wild animals are refused outright.
skills.title_en: A pet nutritionist that forbids bathing your chinchilla

skills.name: trip-map-builder
skills.title_zh: 会替你删掉一半心愿单的行程地图生成器
skills.tagline_zh: 把零散截图和收藏整理成一天一片区的行程，查完点评和小红书，输出可点导航的单页交互地图。
skills.tagline_en: Turns scattered screenshots and saved links into one-neighbourhood-per-day plans, checks dining signals, and ships a single-file interactive map with navigation and reservation buttons.
skills.desc_en: 旅行行程规划技能：规划 → 小红书调研 → 交互式地图页面 | Agent Skill for trip planning with 小红书 research and interactive map generation
skills.why_zh: 它认为你列的东西塞不进去，所以替你删；一天最多安排一个需要订位的地方。
skills.why_en: It states plainly that not everything you listed fits, and deletes for you — one area per day, at most one reservation-required stop per day, and never bend a day around a famous restaurant that's off-route.
skills.limit_zh: 调研环节绑死大众点评和小红书，非中文目的地信号很弱；要装第三方 OpenCLI 并自己开带调试端口的 Chrome；产出的地图是一份静态快照，行程当天不会自己更新。 小红书那段是在你自己开的 Chrome 里拦站内搜索接口取数，账号风险你自己担。
skills.limit_en: Research is wired to Dianping and Xiaohongshu, so non-Chinese destinations get thin signal. Needs the third-party OpenCLI plus a Chrome you launch with a debug port. The map is a static snapshot, not live. The Xiaohongshu step intercepts the site's own search API inside the Chrome you launched — the account risk is yours.
skills.title_en: The itinerary that deletes half your wishlist for you

skills.name: humanizer
skills.title_zh: 只认维基百科那份AI写作痕迹清单的文本去味器
skills.tagline_zh: 改稿时总被说“一看就是AI写的”？它按维基百科的权威清单逐条排查，专治破折号滥用、规则三连、空洞比喻，让文字像人话。
skills.tagline_en: Stuck with robotic prose? It runs your draft against Wikipedia's full list of AI-writing tells—em-dash spam.
skills.desc_en: Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text. Use when editing or reviewing text to make it sound more natural and human-written. Based on Wikipedia's comprehensive "Signs of AI writing" guide. Detects and fixes patterns including: inflated symbolism, promotional language, superficial -ing analyses, vague attributions, em dash overuse, rule of three, AI vocabulary words, negative parallelisms, a
skills.why_zh: 不靠玄学语感，而是把维基百科的《AI写作迹象》指南变成可执行的检查项，逐条比对，改得有理有据。
skills.why_en: Instead of vague advice, it operationalizes Wikipedia's guide into concrete, checkable patterns, so edits are transparent and.
skills.limit_zh: 只处理英文文本；需要联网获取维基百科原文；不保证改写后通过所有AI检测器；对创意写作或口语化文本可能过度修正。
skills.limit_en: English only; needs internet for the Wikipedia source; won't guarantee passing AI detectors; may over-correct creative or colloquial writing.
skills.title_en: De-AI your text with Wikipedia's telltale-signs checklist

skills.name: cook-with-what-you-have
skills.title_zh: 照冰箱剩货挑出三道菜，凑不满也不放宽过敏原
skills.tagline_zh: 报一下冰箱里剩什么，它挑三道可解释的候选，原菜谱一字不改地端出来，缺什么料另写在原文之外。
skills.tagline_en: Tell it what is left in the fridge and it picks three explainable candidates from HowToCook, serving the original recipe text unchanged with the match notes and shopping gaps kept outside it.
skills.desc_en: 根据现有食材、饮食约束和厨具，从 HowToCook 推荐可解释菜谱的本地优先 Agent Skill
skills.why_zh: 原菜谱一字不改地端出来，缺料另写在原文之外——它绝不把 AI 编的菜伪装成 HowToCook 原文。
skills.why_en: The original recipe text comes out untouched, with match notes and shopping gaps kept outside it — it never passes AI-written food off as a HowToCook recipe.
skills.limit_zh: 菜谱库是打包进来的 HowToCook 离线快照，不联网，时间一长就旧，而且原仓库图片没打包、失效的相对链接一律不渲染。它明写「绝不把 AI 生成内容伪装成 HowToCook 原文」——想要 AI 自创菜的人装错了。过敏和忌口是硬过滤，凑不满三个也不放宽。
skills.limit_en: The recipe library is a bundled offline snapshot of HowToCook with no network access, so it ages, and the upstream images are not packaged — broken relative links simply are not rendered. It states outright that AI-written content must never be passed off as HowToCook original text, so anyone wanting invented dishes installed the wrong thing. Allergens and hard restrictions are never relaxed to fill out three options.
skills.title_en: Three dishes from what's in the fridge — or two, if allergens say two

skills.name: threejs-postprocessing
skills.title_zh: 会先问你「要辉光还是景深」的Three.js后期链搭
skills.tagline_zh: 泛光、景深、调色、屏幕特效，不用翻文档拼参数。从 EffectComposer 到自定义着色器，照着装就能出片。
skills.tagline_en: Bloom, DOF, color grading, screen effects — no doc-diving. From EffectComposer to custom shaders, install and.
skills.desc_en: Three.js post-processing - EffectComposer, bloom, DOF, screen effects. Use when adding visual effects, color grading, blur, glow, or creating custom screen-space shaders.
skills.why_zh: 把官方示例里散落的后期链路收敛成可复用的 skill，按场景描述直接给参数组合，省掉你从零搭 comp。
skills.why_en: Consolidates scattered official post-processing chains into reusable recipes — describe the look, get the parameter combo, skip.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆盖 Three.js 生态，不碰 WebGL 原生或 Babylon.js。依赖 r150+ 的 EffectCo。
skills.limit_en: Three.js only, not raw WebGL or Babylon. Requires r150+ EffectComposer API; older versions break. Provides snippets and wiring notes, not a full.
skills.title_en: A Three.js post-processing chain builder that asks 'bloom.

skills.name: zhuanye-rensheng-tiyan
skills.title_zh: 十分钟活完计算机专业，带走一份该问真程序员的清单
skills.tagline_zh: 十分钟纯选项文字游戏，替高考生把计算机专业从大一活到 35 岁。出身在前两幕起作用，第三幕不再让它继续拉大差距。
skills.tagline_en: A ten-minute all-choices text game that walks a high-school senior through a computer science degree from freshman year to thirty-five. Background shapes the first two acts and stops widening the gap in the third.
skills.desc_en: 人生重开·选专业版 — 让高考生提前"活一遍"某专业毕业后人生的 AI 文字游戏 Skill
skills.why_zh: 禁止给薪资均值，只说「分两拨人」；铁律写着「诚实是承认牌不一样，羞辱是暗示输牌的人不配」。
skills.why_en: No average salaries allowed — only "two groups of people". Its rule reads: honesty is admitting the hands differ; humiliation is implying whoever lost deserved to.
skills.limit_zh: v1 只有计算机一个专业，别的专业玩不了。正文自认「真实性此刻靠模型的行业知识加铁律兜底，还没有查证内容包」，并明说不要宣称数据权威。出身设定刻意不问性别，理由是评审认定那一项最容易翻车。
skills.limit_en: Version one covers computer science only; no other major is playable. The file admits its realism currently rests on the model's industry knowledge plus its own guardrails, with no verified content pack yet, and says not to claim the numbers are authoritative. It also deliberately never asks your gender, because reviewers judged that variable the easiest one to get wrong.
skills.title_en: Live a CS degree in ten minutes, leave with questions for a real engineer

skills.name: bluey-parenting
skills.title_zh: 先让你冷水冲手腕 10 秒，再翻《布鲁伊》第几集
skills.tagline_zh: 「我又吼了他」——这时它不讲道理，先给一个 30 秒能做完的动作，再翻出班迪特也敷衍过孩子的那一集，标上季集号。
skills.tagline_en: "I yelled at him again." At that point it skips the reasoning, gives you one thing you can do in thirty seconds, then pulls up the episode where Bandit also fobbed his kids off — with the season and number.
skills.desc_en: 布鲁伊父母支持 - 基于Bluey动画片的育儿支持Coze技能
skills.why_zh: 四种入口走四条路：要点子的那一路明写「不先共情，直接给游戏」，五分钟能准备好。
skills.why_en: Four entry points, four different routes. The one for parents who just want an idea says outright: skip the empathy, hand over the game, five minutes of prep.
skills.limit_zh: 它的主要语料是一部动画片——没看过《布鲁伊》的人，剧集对照那一半是空的。心理学补位只在 P.E.T.、依恋理论、Gottman 等七个框架里选，必须写出提出者，「心理学研究表明」这种说法被禁掉了。剧集链接指向 B 站正版，要能访问才用得上。
skills.limit_en: Its main corpus is a cartoon, so half of it is empty if you have never watched Bluey. Psychology only fills gaps from seven named frameworks — P.E.T., attachment theory, Gottman and others — and must name whoever proposed it, with vague phrasing like "studies show" banned outright. Episode links point to the licensed Bilibili stream, which you need to be able to reach.
skills.title_en: Cold water on your wrists for ten seconds, then which Bluey episode

skills.name: csp
skills.title_zh: 只写「她会怎么反应」不抄台词的角色蒸馏器
skills.tagline_zh: 本地脚本检索萌娘百科等站点，五路并行调研，交叉验证后蒸出三到七条可执行的行为规则。
skills.tagline_en: Runs local scripted retrieval over character wikis, five parallel research agents, cross-validates every load-bearing claim, then distils three to seven executable behaviour rules.
skills.desc_en: Character Skill Producer — distill anime characters into executable agent skills
skills.why_zh: 它抓的是她怎么行动，不是她说过什么：标签给人看，行为规则给 AI 执行。
skills.why_en: The stated distinction: capture HOW she behaves, not WHAT she said — tags are for humans, behaviour rules are for the agent to run. Anything it can't ground stays a declared boundary.
skills.limit_zh: 要 Python，且默认只跑最高保真模式，很费 token；来源黑名单排除知乎、公众号和百度百科；生成的角色包会写死资料截止日期，作品一出新剧情就得重跑。
skills.limit_en: Needs Python and runs highest-fidelity mode only, which burns tokens. Zhihu, WeChat articles and Baidu Baike are blacklisted as sources. Every generated pack stamps a data cutoff date and needs a rerun when the work updates.
skills.title_en: It writes how she behaves, not what she said

skills.name: surreal-pop-collage
skills.title_zh: 照片收成超现实波普拼贴
skills.tagline_zh: 黑白现实当锚，全图只许一个不可能的巨物
skills.tagline_en: Desaturates your photo into a black-and-white reality anchor, replaces the world behind it with two or three huge flat colour shapes, then drops in exactly one impossible object.
skills.desc_en: 把照片变成超现实波普拼贴的 AI agent skill：黑白现实锚点 + 平涂色形 + 全图只有一个不可能的巨物。An agent skill that turns photos into surreal pop collages.
skills.why_zh: 平涂色形叠在黑白锚点上。不可能的东西只出现一次，多了就不是这件。
skills.why_en: The whole force of the surreal is that only one thing is wrong. A second impossible element gets deleted, and every colour must trace back to a hue already in your photo.
skills.limit_zh: 要写实、要满屏彩蛋、要多只巨物，卸掉。
skills.limit_en: It writes the prompt and calls whatever image model you've wired up — output quality is that model's. Vertical 3:4 by default. Chinese text must be composited afterward, never put in the prompt. One retry only.
skills.title_en: One impossible giant, and nothing else out of place

skills.name: teach-me
skills.title_zh: 会打断你含糊用词的苏格拉底式陪练
skills.tagline_zh: 先把话题铺成一棵树，分清哪一层只是分支、哪一层才是研究者真在吵的分歧，然后一路反问你。
skills.tagline_en: Maps your topic into a tree, separates the branches researchers agree on from the tensions they actually publish against each other over, and questions you down the path.
