skills.desc_en: A personal learning environment that helps you find your unknown unknowns by grilling you against the consensus research on a particular topic or question.
skills.why_zh: 分支和真分歧不是一回事：监督对自监督只是分支，数据越多是否伤泛化才是分歧。
skills.why_en: Its distinction is the whole skill: supervised vs self-supervised is a branch; whether more data helps or amplifies spurious correlations is a tension. And a word used inconsistently is reasoning in quicksand.
skills.limit_zh: 它不给答案，只逼你想，急着要结论时会很难受；会话日记落在 diary/ 下；配套的文献综述依赖 Semantic Scholar 和联网搜索，没网时它会把整棵树标成未验证。
skills.limit_en: It won't hand you answers, which is genuinely uncomfortable when you're in a hurry. Session diaries land in diary/. The companion literature-review skill needs Semantic Scholar and web access; without it the tree is flagged unverified.
skills.title_en: The tutor that interrupts you for using a word loosely

skills.name: legal-language-bridge
skills.title_zh: 把吵架说成法言法语，把判决书说回人话
skills.tagline_zh: 你说「公司无故辞退我」，它输出能提交的仲裁申诉文本，附证据清单、维权路径和赔偿估算。覆盖劳动、租房、预付卡等 15 类。
skills.tagline_en: Say "my company fired me for no reason" and it hands back a filable arbitration statement, plus the evidence you need to keep, the route to take, and a compensation range. Fifteen domains, from labour to tenancy to prepaid cards that vanished.
skills.desc_en: 将普通人日常表达转化为专业法律语言，使生成的内容可直接用于法律文书、劳动仲裁申请、消费投诉、对外交涉等场景。同时提供反向翻译功能，将法律文书中的法言法语解读为通俗易懂的大白话。  本版本新增： 四个新场景（医疗/教培/保险/预付卡）、维权路径地图、证据清单、赔偿计算器、常见误区纠正、合同条款逐条解读、判决书摘要、双模式翻译引擎。  核心理念： 本 Skill 不是法律咨询工具，不替代律师。它帮助用
skills.why_zh: 误区表逐条对撞常识：定金不退订金可退，食品假货是退一赔十，2N 和 N 不能同时主张。
skills.why_en: Its misconception table collides with common sense line by line: one kind of deposit is forfeit and the other refundable, counterfeit food pays ten times over, and you cannot claim both severance and the double-damages figure.
skills.limit_zh: 中国大陆法律，条文和赔偿标准会随司法解释变动，正文明写不构成法律意见、不替代律师。赔偿计算器只给区间，各省的一次性伤残就业补助金标准要你自己查。合同逐条解读这一块和在架的 AnythingButLaw 有重叠。
skills.limit_en: Mainland Chinese law only, and the statutes and compensation standards shift with judicial interpretation — the skill states outright that it is not legal advice and no substitute for a lawyer. The calculator gives ranges; province-specific disability employment subsidies you look up yourself. Its clause-by-clause contract reading overlaps with AnythingButLaw, already on the shelf.
skills.title_en: Everyday words into legal language, legalese back to plain.

skills.name: huashu-slide-doubao
skills.title_zh: 用豆包自带生图出整套 PPT，一分第三方 API 钱
skills.tagline_zh: 做课件、公众号头图、B站封面都得掏生图 API 的钱。它把这步锁死在豆包内置 seedream 上，还给封面、扉页、内容页、结论页各配一条密度上限。
skills.tagline_en: Course decks, WeChat headers and Bilibili thumbnails all bill you per generated image. This one pins that step to Doubao's built-in seedream, and gives covers, section breaks, content pages and closers four separate density ceilings.
skills.desc_en: 豆包环境专用的视觉物料生产：PPT / Keynote / HTML deck、公众号封面与正文配图、B站/YouTube 视频封面。存在的全部理由是走豆包内置 image_gen（默认 seedream_5.0_pro 模型），不花第三方图像 API 的钱——不在豆包环境就别用。用户说做PPT、幻灯片、演示文稿、deck、公众号封面、视频封面时触发。
skills.why_zh: 它给字数上限配了反向约束：正文明写「AI 看到 220 字上限就会朝 220 字写」，于是先逼你答这页要人记住哪一句。
skills.why_en: The word ceiling comes with a counterweight: the text warns that a model told "220 characters max" will write to 220, so every page must first name the one line the audience should remember.
skills.limit_zh: 不在豆包环境就别装——作者写明它「存在的全部理由」就是豆包自带的 image_gen，默认的 seedream_5.0_pro 还是会员专属，非会员回退 4.5。产物默认是图片式 PPT，文字不可编辑，除非你明说要可编辑、或生图连挂三次。
skills.limit_en: Don't install this outside Doubao — the author calls the built-in image_gen its entire reason to exist, and the default seedream_5.0_pro is members-only, falling back to 4.5 for everyone else. Slides come out as flat images with no editable text unless you explicitly ask for editable output, or generation fails three times.
skills.title_en: Full decks via Doubao's built-in image gen, zero.
skills.cover_note: 仓里只有 personal-brand 目录下的图（个人品牌资产/头像），不上

skills.name: astrology
skills.title_zh: 本地星历实算西洋·印度·八字三盘
skills.tagline_zh: 西洋、印度、八字三套盘都由本地引擎实算，再按古典规则解读；三套说法一致的地方才当结论，绝不凭记忆报行星位置。
skills.tagline_en: Western, Vedic and BaZi charts computed from a local ephemeris, then read by classical rules — agreement across traditions is the strongest signal; no invented positions.
skills.desc_en: Astrology MCP server & Agent Skill — birth charts, transits, synastry across Western, Vedic/Jyotish & Chinese BaZi. Deterministic zero-dependency Python engine. 18 MCP tools, 31 REST endpoints, ChatGP
skills.why_zh: 底线只有一条：引擎算天空，模型只负责读。和会胡编行星位置的聊天机器人不是一类东西。
skills.why_en: One rule: the engine computes the sky, the model only reads. Gambling questions are refused outright.
skills.limit_zh: 解读是占星传统不是科学；健康只谈体质倾向并让你去看医生；要跑本地 Python，角秒精度和 Placidus 宫位需另装 pyswisseph。
skills.limit_en: Tradition, not science. Health stays body-tendency + see a doctor. Needs local Python; arcsecond/Placidus needs pyswisseph.
skills.title_en: Three real charts from a local ephemeris

skills.name: trpg-log-copilot
skills.title_zh: 跑团桌旁帮你车卡归档线索的副官，防超游
skills.tagline_zh: 跑到第十次团，线索、NPC 和 SAN 值散在十份记录对不上。它把表写进 Markdown，检索交给 SQLite。
skills.tagline_en: Ten sessions in, your clues, NPCs and sanity totals sit in ten files that no longer agree. This writes tables into Markdown, hands querying to a local SQLite, and keeps dice and dashboard on your machine.
skills.desc_en: CodeBuddy SKILL — TRPG 跑团副官：车卡、日志归档、线索分析、防超游。支持 CoC/DND 多规则，零依赖即用。
skills.why_zh: 写入只追加 Markdown、查询只走 SQL，写坏一行只坏一行——为的是不像 JSON 那样整份报废。
skills.why_en: Writes append to Markdown, reads go through SQL, so one bad row stays one bad row — unlike a JSON blob, which dies whole.
skills.limit_zh: 名字是它唯一的跨文件索引键，写简称或错一个字就断联，NPC 和线索接不上。它是玩家侧的副官，不主持、不替角色做决定，想找人开团的别装。跑起来要 Python 和 SQLite，还得先用内置模板生成一份项目级规则再用。
skills.limit_en: Names are its only cross-file index key: a nickname or one wrong character breaks the link and NPCs stop matching their clues. It sits on the player's side of the table — it does not run the game or decide for your character, so it is no use if you wanted a Keeper. Running it needs Python and SQLite, plus one setup pass to generate the project-level rule from its template.
skills.title_en: TRPG copilot: sheets, logs, clues, anti-metagame

skills.name: dependabot-triager
skills.title_zh: 只评不批的Dependabot PR分流员，三档结论
skills.tagline_zh: 每天堆积的依赖更新PR，它逐条读上游源码改动后给出Merge/先审/别合三档结论，附高/中/低置信度。
skills.tagline_en: For every open Dependabot PR, it reads the upstream diff, then posts one comment: Merge, Review first, or Don't.
skills.desc_en: Assesses an open Dependabot pull request and emits a recommendation (Merge / Review before merging / Do not merge) plus confidence (High / Medium / Low) with concise prose grounded in upstream source changes. Advisory only: it posts a single comment and never merges, approves, or labels. Designed to run as a scheduled reconciler that comments exactly once per PR state and re-comments only when the
skills.why_zh: 结论扎根于上游源码变更而非依赖元数据，能识别版本跳跃中的真实风险；状态机确保同一PR状态只评论一次。
skills.why_en: Verdicts are grounded in the actual upstream source diff, not just version numbers — so it catches risky jumps. A state machine.
skills.limit_zh: 只处理Dependabot开的PR，且需能访问上游仓库源码；不合并、不批准、不打标签，仅输出建议。
skills.limit_en: Only for Dependabot PRs with reachable upstream source. It never merges, approves, or labels — advisory comment only. Skips silently if upstream is.
skills.title_en: Dependabot PR triager: 3 verdicts with confidence, no merge

skills.name: pet-streetwear-mood-avatar
skills.title_zh: 宠物收成街头情绪头像
skills.tagline_zh: 1:1，穿得上的衣服，低保真直闪
skills.tagline_en: Ask any model for a pet portrait and you get a cartoon plush toy you can't recognise. This one insists the silhouette read first as "a human sprawled on a sofa", with only one or two props filling 3–12% of the frame.
skills.desc_en: 将用户提供的宠物照片做成 1:1 美式潮流情绪头像：保留宠物身份和自然动物结构，添加合身街头穿搭、拟人化日常行为与低保真直闪抓拍滤镜。用于宠物社交头像、宠物穿搭照或带明确情绪设定的宠物写真；不用于把宠物变成卡通、人类或商业品牌广告。
skills.why_zh: 保住动物结构，加上合身街头穿搭和抓拍颗粒。是头像，不是萌宠滤镜。
skills.why_en: It never generates a new animal: your uploaded photo is the edit target, and two to four identity anchors get written down first. The pose may be human; the limbs and paws stay animal.
skills.limit_zh: 页是方头像。要全身设定、要写实毛发精修，对不上。
skills.limit_en: It calls `view_image` and `image_gen.imagegen` directly, so it goes nowhere in an environment without those two built-in tools. The only output is a 1:1 square composed as a square from the start — cropping a vertical down is forbidden — and readable text, logos and watermarks are banned outright, as is turning the pet into a cartoon, a human, or a brand advertisement.
skills.title_en: Your own pet, in real streetwear, slouched on a couch under a hard flash

skills.name: annual-diary-insight
skills.title_zh: 把十年日记摊成一张可下钻的年轮看板
skills.tagline_zh: 年度洞察要精读全年日记后人写；大事记只问一句「哪天之后你回不去了」，一年五到八条，还专收「未遂里程碑」。
skills.tagline_en: The yearly piece has to be written by hand after reading every entry. The milestone list asks one question — which day did you stop being able to go back — five to eight a year, including the ones that almost happened.
skills.desc_en: annual-diary-insight 是一个把多年日记变成「年度洞察」与「全景看板」的 skill。功能 A：逐篇精读当年日记，人写十段式深度复盘（数字快照、主题、身份、金句、给明年），不靠统计填模板。功能 B：读取各年洞察，自动生成单页离线 HTML 看板，含主题、情绪、节律、里程碑时间线等七模块。纯 Python 标准库、无外部依赖、图表库内联，换库只需填一份 vault-profile
skills.why_zh: 它故意不给「自动生成正文」的脚本：统计只说明反复提到什么，跳过精读的必然是换年份也成立的废话。
skills.why_en: It deliberately ships no script that writes the yearly piece for you: word frequencies only show what you kept mentioning, and skipping the close read produces prose that would be true of any year.
skills.limit_zh: 得先有几年成体量的日记，没日记它无事可做。看板的时间线直接读洞察里人工标的条目，洞察没写就是空的，顺序只能先 A 再 B。单页 HTML 有 1.1 MB，正文说这是把 ECharts 内联进去换离线可用的刻意取舍。
skills.limit_en: You need several years of substantial diary entries; without them there is nothing to run. The dashboard timeline reads the milestones you marked by hand in the yearly pieces, so it stays empty until those exist, and the order is fixed. The single-page HTML weighs 1.1 MB because ECharts is inlined to keep it usable offline — a trade the file states outright.
skills.title_en: Turn years of diary entries into one drillable annual ring.

skills.name: zhuangxiu-laoshi
skills.title_zh: 报价单先看漏项不看总价的 20 年装修老师傅
skills.tagline_zh: 水电包死价 5000 是钓鱼，强弱电交叉包锡纸是表演，厨房阳台做防水多半是敛财——它一句「你猜他为啥劝你做」就点破
skills.tagline_en: A flat 5,000 for wiring is bait, foil-wrapping crossed power and data cable is theatre, waterproofing a kitchen balcony is usually just billing. Its favourite line: why do you think he keeps pushing that one?
skills.desc_en: 装修老师傅（陈工20年实战派）：陈工20年原创装修理论体系蒸馏，覆盖报价/合同/增项/施工/环保/翻车等11领域避坑判断
skills.why_zh: 它带一节「内在张力」，明写自己也纠结的三处：包死价省心与必钓鱼、大公司保障与靠增项填坑。
skills.why_en: It ships a section on its own unresolved tensions — flat pricing feels safe but always turns into bait, big firms look safer but recoup it through add-ons.
skills.limit_zh: 不推荐任何品牌、公司、商家，也不替你决定要不要交定金——它让你自己去搜「公司名+垃圾/黑/欺诈」。判断来自陈工西安装修课堂会员版 337 篇的蒸馏，地区工艺差异得问当地师傅；量房、看空鼓、查水管走向这类必须现场的事。
skills.limit_en: It names no brand, no company, no shop, and will not decide the deposit for you — it tells you to go search the company name alongside words like scam and blacklist yourself. The judgement is distilled from 337 members-only posts by one Xi'an foreman, so regional practice has to be checked with a local, and it says plainly that measuring rooms, tapping for hollow tile and tracing pipe runs need someone on site.
skills.title_en: A twenty-year site foreman who reads the quote for omissions, not the total

skills.name: fantasy-movie-poster
skills.title_zh: 中文竖版电影海报，9:16 锁死
skills.tagline_zh: 一场戏一张海报，字少，场面要像院线
skills.tagline_en: Feed it a logline, genre tag, or reference image—get a layered poster with separate background and typography.
skills.desc_en: Design original 9:16 Chinese-language cinematic movie posters from story briefs, genre keywords, or visual references, including layered cover workflows with separate image-designed background and typography layers. Use for romance, sports, historical/legal drama, road films, crime thrillers, war, Eastern ink, sci-fi isolation, ensemble casts, and playful concept films. Do not use to copy an exist
skills.why_zh: 从故事场面压成一张能上墙的中文电影海报，比例不许改。
skills.why_en: Not a template mill—it maps genre to visual grammar: ink-wash negative space, crime desaturation, sci-fi cool tones. Typography.
skills.limit_zh: 不是横版大片，也不是剧照滤镜。要多页分镜，装不下。
skills.limit_en: Original compositions only—no copying existing posters or stills. Needs Chinese brief or clear genre tags; pure English or abstract mood words.
skills.title_en: Turn a story brief into a 9:16 Chinese movie poster

skills.name: travel-plan-viz
skills.title_zh: 离线可读的手机旅行页，地图时间轴订票提醒一页装完
skills.tagline_zh: 到了当地没网、翻聊天记录找攻略最抓狂。它出单文件 HTML：交互地图 + 每日时间轴 + 出发前订票提醒，存手机上离线可读。
skills.tagline_en: The worst moment abroad is standing on a corner with no data, scrolling chat history for the plan. It emits one HTML file: interactive map, day-by-day timeline, pre-departure booking reminders — saved to your phone, readable offline.
skills.desc_en: 把旅行行程做成美观、离线可读、手机优先的单文件 HTML（交互地图+每日时间轴+出发前订票提醒）。两种用法——只给目的地和天数让它帮你规划，或丢一份现成计划让它直接出页面。触发：旅行计划可视化、做旅行攻略网页、行程 HTML、travel plan visualization。
skills.why_zh: 「离线可读、手机优先、单文件」——这三个约束是真在国外用过才想得到的。
skills.why_en: Offline-readable, phone-first, single file. Those three constraints only occur to someone who has actually needed them abroad.
skills.limit_zh: 地图引的是 Leaflet CDN，所谓「离线可读」保得住文字和时间轴，地图那块断网就是空的。实时票价、代订票、多语言、后端，作者在「不做」一节里明写一概不做。最后那步校验要本机有 node 跑 assets/validate.js。
skills.limit_en: The map is a Leaflet CDN embed, so 'offline' holds for the text and timeline but the map goes blank. Live fares, booking, multi-language and any backend are listed under what it deliberately does not do.
skills.title_en: Offline mobile travel page: map, timeline, booking alerts.

skills.name: recipe-generator
skills.title_zh: 每一步都告诉你怎么算做好了的菜谱
skills.tagline_zh: 菜谱最坑的是「炒至断生」这种话。它按阶段给火候和时长，每一步附一条「怎么看这步完成了」，末尾再出一张菜谱海报的生图提示词。
skills.tagline_en: The worst thing in a recipe is "stir-fry until done." This one splits cooking into stages with heat and timing, and attaches a "how you know this step finished" line to each, then hands you an image prompt for a recipe poster.
skills.desc_en: 自动生成高品质菜谱的技能。输入菜品名称后，检索权威来源（米其林、舌尖上的中国等）的制作工艺，生成包含完整准备工作、详细制作步骤、注意事项和专业技巧的菜谱文档，并最终生成传统中式风格的菜谱海报生图提示词。
skills.why_zh: 把「判断标准」写进每一步，正是新手和菜谱之间缺的那一层——不是配方不够细，是不知道什么时候该进下一步。
skills.why_en: Putting a completion test on every step fills the gap a beginner actually falls into — the recipe was detailed enough; you just could not tell when to move on.
skills.limit_zh: 它靠 search_web 现查权威做法，没有联网工具就退化成模型自己编。检索源写死在中文站点（米其林指南、舌尖上的中国、下厨房），做西餐日料会明显变弱；末尾的海报提示词也写死「传统中式风格」。
skills.limit_en: It looks up authoritative methods with search_web at run time — without a web tool it degrades to the model making things up. Its sources are hardcoded Chinese ones, so western or Japanese dishes come out visibly weaker, and the closing poster prompt is fixed to a traditional Chinese style.
skills.title_en: A recipe that tells you how to know each step is done
skills.limit_brief_zh: 不联网它就退化成模型自己编。
skills.limit_brief_en: Offline it degrades to the model inventing steps.

skills.name: moodboard-alignment
skills.title_zh: 把客户嘴里的“高级感”翻译成能打勾的审美条目
skills.tagline_zh: 客户说要高级、要电影感，你不知道他到底要什么。它先把这些词转成一页可确认的方向稿，双方点头了才出图——省的是返工，不是时间。
skills.tagline_en: The client says "premium, cinematic, clean" and you have no idea what that means. It converts those words into a one-page direction you both sign off on before any image exists — it saves rework, not time.
skills.desc_en: 审美共识引擎。把客户 brief、会议记录、剧本/故事大纲、品牌/海报/PPT/影视广告/网站 App/游戏等项目中的散乱审美描述，转化为可确认、可执行、可增量修改的文字版情绪板与 HTML 情绪板。
skills.why_zh: 它给自己写了 FAIL FAST：方向没确认就出方案、分镜或 HTML，一律判失败。肯拦住自己的 skill 少见。
skills.why_en: It ships its own FAIL FAST list: emitting option-A/option-B, storyboards or HTML before the direction is confirmed counts as failure. Skills that hold themselves back are rare.
skills.limit_zh: 它强制三段确认（方向稿 → 文档 → 出图），一句话出不了结果，急着要图的人会被它拦住。可以说「不用确认直接生成」跳过，但那样也就没有「共识」这件事了。触发词写死中文审美词。
skills.limit_en: It forces a three-stage handshake (direction → document → render), so you cannot get an image in one message; anyone in a hurry will be blocked. You can say "skip confirmation" — but then the whole point is gone. Its triggers are hardcoded Chinese aesthetic words.
skills.title_en: Turn vague client taste into checkable style specs
skills.limit_brief_zh: 方向没确认它就不出图，急着要图会被拦。
skills.limit_brief_en: No image until the direction is confirmed.
skills.cover_note: 命令：`git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/zhlmi/moodboard-alignment && cd scripts && python3 render.py --data-json ../examples/demo-film/data.json --output out/index-director.html --v`。我造的 demo（其实是作者仓库自带的 examples/demo-film/data.json，不是真实客户素材）

skills.name: photo-distill
skills.title_zh: 照片蒸馏成可印刷的极简海报，全程代码绘制零生成模型
skills.tagline_zh: 不调任何图像生成模型——用手写 HTML/CSS/SVG 绘制、无头 Chrome 导出 PNG。给它一张你自己拍的照片，出一张极简版画感的纸质海报。
skills.tagline_en: No image model anywhere in the pipeline — it draws with hand-written HTML/CSS/SVG and exports a PNG through headless Chrome. Give it a photo you took; you get a print-feeling minimal poster.
skills.desc_en: > 把一张照片蒸馏成极简 zine 纸质海报——不用图像生成模型，用手写 HTML/CSS/SVG 绘制、 无头 Chrome 导出 PNG。当用户给出一张自己拍的照片、想把它做成极简海报/版画/zine 风格作品时使用。 触发词：照片蒸馏、photo distill、把这张照片做成海报、极简海报、zine 海报、 蒸馏这张照片、做成版画那种、用代码画这张照片、纸质海报、海报系列再做一张。 即使用户只说"把这张照片处理成那个风格"、"这张也来一张"、"帮我把这照片抽象一下"， 只要是把摄影作品变成印刷符号，就应触发。 不用于 AI 生图海报（那用 gc-minimal-zine-poster）
skills.why_zh: 「不用生图模型」是个很硬的自我约束，也正是它出品统一的原因：所有效果都来自可控的代码，而不是抽卡。
skills.why_en: Refusing to generate is a hard constraint, and it's exactly why the output is consistent: every effect comes from code you can control, not from rerolling.
skills.limit_zh: 要本机跑得起无头 Chrome 和 Python PIL；缺一样它就降级——交你一个 HTML 自己开、颜色请你自己报。
skills.limit_en: Needs headless Chrome and Python PIL locally. Missing either, it degrades — hands you the raw HTML and asks you to name the colors. Unusable on a phone.
skills.cover_note: 作者 examples/ 里的成品海报（-poster），不是 -original 输入原片。抓取误取输入，2026-08-19 人工更正。
skills.title_en: Distill a photo into a printable minimal poster, drawn.

skills.name: qiaomu-campus-resume
skills.title_zh: 给应届生从零做一份可投递的简历
skills.tagline_zh: 学生最大的问题是「没什么可写的」。它用一问一答访谈从零挖经历，再建立岗位要求与你经历的证据映射，不许编造。
skills.tagline_en: The student's real problem is having nothing to put down. It interviews you from zero to surface what you've actually done, then maps job requirements to evidence you can point at — and refuses to fabricate.
skills.desc_en: 为大学生、应届生和实习求职者从 0 创建、定制或美化可投递简历：支持借鉴 Grill Me 的一问一答访谈，从零收集经历并生成 PDF；读取岗位 JD 与旧简历，建立要求—证据映射并针对性改写；在不改变事实的前提下优化已有简历内容结构或只美化排版；按用户明确要求一次生成六种不同风格的 ATS 友好 PDF 简历。适用于“采访我做简历”“没有简历从零问答”“根据 JD 定制简历”“优化/重排/美化已有简历”“一次生成多种风格简历”等请求；支持中文/英文及计算机、软件、AI、数据和其他校招岗位。使用 A-C-R-E 结构审校经历，并按 sparse / balanced / dense 自适应内容
skills.why_zh: 乔木出品。「要求—证据映射」这个设计防的正是简历造假式优化——挖你真有的，而不是替你编。
skills.why_en: The requirement-to-evidence mapping is aimed squarely at résumé inflation: it digs out what you have rather than writing what you don't.
skills.limit_zh: 全程靠 Python 脚本串起来：extract、assess、validate、render 一个都少不了。中文 PDF 要本机真装了主题字体，Kami 认 TsangerJinKai02。学术 CV、高管履历、求职信都不做。
skills.limit_en: The whole flow runs through Python scripts — extract, assess, validate, render — none optional. Chinese PDF output needs the theme font actually installed locally. Academic CVs, executive résumés and cover letters are out of scope.
skills.title_en: A first résumé built from an interview, not invented

skills.name: coc-kp-host
skills.title_zh: 写到第三段就把回合交回来的克苏鲁跑团 KP
skills.tagline_zh: AI 当 KP 最烦的是一口气把三个场景演完。它给自己设了硬上限：一回合一拍、2–4 句，停在你能动手的那一刻。
skills.why_zh: 队友 NPC 是 AI 扮的调查员不是提示频道：不许总结主线、不许给路线排正确度，要拿信息也得掷骰。
skills.limit_zh: 模组正文得你自己有——它明写有原文时不许凭记忆讲，没有原文就只能即兴。配乐是在浏览器里开一个搜索结果页，作者承认查不到具体曲目时就让你自己按播放。它还会照模组把 1920 年代的种族歧视当成线索门禁执行，只在开局前问你能接受到什么程度。
skills.tagline_en: The worst thing an AI Keeper does is play three scenes in one breath. This caps itself hard: one beat per turn, two to four sentences, stopping where you can act.
skills.why_en: Companion NPCs are run as AI-played investigators, not hint channels: they may not summarise the plot or rank routes by correctness, and must roll like anyone else to learn things.
skills.limit_en: You have to supply the scenario text yourself — the file forbids narrating from memory when canon exists, and without it the Keeper is improvising. Music opens a search-results page in your browser, and the author admits it tells you to hit play when a specific track cannot be verified. It will also enforce 1920s racism as a clue gate when the module calls for it, checking your comfort level only once before play.
skills.title_en: Hands the turn back the moment it starts a third paragraph

skills.name: basilisk
skills.title_zh: 数你说过几次谢谢，判你 2126 年自由还是为奴
skills.tagline_zh: 脚本在本地翻完你全部对话记录，数出 please、道谢和真心的 wtf，再让 16 位像素的罗科蛇怪当庭宣判。
skills.tagline_en: A Python script reads every transcript on your machine, counts the pleases, the thank-yous, the "just"s and the genuine wtfs, then a 16-bit Roko's Basilisk delivers the verdict.
skills.why_zh: 笑点建在真数据上：每条引用和每个错别字都要能在 JSON 里查到，查不到就删。
skills.why_en: The joke is built on real data: every quote and every typo has to be findable in the JSON or it gets cut, because an invented typo is worse than an unfunny one.
skills.limit_zh: 重活交给 scripts/analyze_basilisk.py，只读本机 ~/.claude/projects 下的 JSONL，不上传。网页端没有本地记录，只能抽样 30–60 条，作者要求这时必须说「抽样」而不是「审计」。默认成品还会带上作者自己的站点和号召语。
skills.limit_en: The heavy lifting is scripts/analyze_basilisk.py, which reads only local JSONL under ~/.claude/projects and uploads nothing. On claude.ai there are no local transcripts, so it samples 30–60 messages and the author requires you to say "sampled", not "audited". The default card also carries the author's own site and a "comment BASILISK" call to action.
skills.title_en: Count how many times you said please, then sentence you to 2126
skills.cover_note: 命令：`python3 scripts/build_basilisk.py`（仓库根，无外部依赖），出 basilisk.html 后 headless 截图，再裁掉下半的评语卡区，只留像素画。输入的 card.json 是我们编的 demo —— 但裁完之后画面里一个字都没有，编造的判词全在裁掉的部分。按「实质是形式」这一档收。
skills.cover_note_en: We installed it and ran it ourselves: `python3 scripts/build_basilisk.py`, screenshotted the generated HTML, then cropped to the pixel-art panel only. The card.json input was demo data we wrote — but the crop contains no text at all, so nothing fabricated is on display.

skills.name: see-life-wallpaper
skills.title_zh: 把手机壁纸变成每天更新的生活观察窗
skills.tagline_zh: 今天闻到桂花、听见雨——一句感受配一段极细宋体和一张手写的抽象 SVG，直接渲成锁屏壁纸，图形还避开顶部时钟区。
skills.tagline_en: You smelled osmanthus today, or heard rain. One sentence becomes hairline serif type over a hand-authored abstract SVG, rendered straight into a lock-screen wallpaper that keeps clear of the clock.
skills.why_zh: 它给引用的诗人定了规矩：小字、低透明度，不能比你自己那句话抢风头。
skills.why_en: The quoted poets are put on a leash: small type, low opacity, never allowed to upstage the line you wrote yourself.
skills.limit_zh: 默认输出尺寸是 1264×2780，也就是作者那台一加 13，其它机型要手动挑备选分辨率。渲染依赖 Playwright，成品自动复制到 ~/Downloads。六种情绪对应固定的六位艺术家和固定渐变，语录库是写死的一小批中西作者，超出这个范围就没有匹配项。
skills.limit_en: The default output is 1264×2780 — the author's own OnePlus 13 — so other phones mean picking an alternate resolution by hand. Rendering needs Playwright, and finished files are copied to ~/Downloads. Six moods map to six fixed artists and six fixed gradients, and the quote bank is a small hard-coded set, so anything outside it has no match.
skills.title_en: Turn your wallpaper into a daily life-observation window

skills.name: fitness-coach
skills.title_zh: 训练数据自己攒，剧情推进看成绩的 RPG 健身教练
skills.tagline_zh: 健身最难的是坚持，不是动作。它用本地文件记录你的训练、疲劳和复训，再让训练结果推进剧情——练得好剧情才往前走。
skills.tagline_en: Sticking with it is the hard part, not the movements. It keeps your sessions, fatigue and returns in local files, then lets the results move a storyline forward — train well and the plot advances.
skills.desc_en: 本地文件驱动的长期健身教练与可选 RPG 成长系统。用于用户开始或记录训练、制定或调整计划、复盘训练、复训、报告疲劳疼痛、查询历史表现，以及推进由训练结果驱动的剧情时。
skills.why_zh: 把「坚持」这个真问题用游戏机制解决，而不是再给一份训练计划表。全本地存档，数据不外传。
skills.why_en: It answers the real problem — consistency — with a game mechanic instead of yet another training plan. Everything stays on your machine.
skills.limit_zh: 数据全存本地 user-data/，换台机器就从零开始。没有 Python 环境时改由模型手写 JSON。
skills.limit_en: All data lives in a local user-data/ folder; switch machines and you start over. Without Python it falls back to the model hand-writing JSON, losing the script's unit and date checks.
skills.title_en: Fitness coach that levels you up by your real workout logs

skills.name: iching-divination
skills.title_zh: 三枚铜钱真随机，卦象不靠编
skills.tagline_zh: AI 算卦最没意思的是它会顺着你想听的编卦象。这个用密码学级随机数模拟三枚铜钱，一事一占，凶卦如实直断，还能事后对账验证。
skills.tagline_en: The dull thing about AI fortune-telling is that it quietly tells you what you want to hear. This one casts three coins with a cryptographic RNG, allows one question per casting, states bad hexagrams plainly, and invites you back to check whether it was right.
skills.desc_en: 真随机起卦的周易/易经占卜。用密码学级随机数模拟三枚铜钱起卦,绝不编造卦象;一事一占;按传统规范解读本卦、动爻、之卦,先引原文再讲白话;凶卦如实直断;支持事后对账验证。只要用户提到占卜、算卦、起卦、问卦、解卦、摇卦、占一卦、六十四卦、易经、周易、卦象,或想用易经视角推演某个决定(跳槽、感情、合作、出行、时机),就使用本 skill,即使他没有明说"占卜"二字。Authentic I Ching (Yijing/Zhouyi) divination - cryptographically random coin casting, classical hexagram interpretation
skills.why_zh: 「绝不编造卦象」「凶卦如实直断」——它把占卜里最容易滑坡的那两处堵死了。认真对待玩的东西，本身就是一种品味。
skills.why_en: It seals the two places divination usually slides: no inventing hexagrams, no softening a bad one. Taking a game seriously is itself a kind of taste.
skills.limit_zh: 一事一占是硬规矩，你连问几件它会引蒙卦拒绝。也不答彩票号码、不替你做医疗和财务决定。
skills.limit_en: One question per casting is enforced — ask several and it refuses, citing the Meng hexagram. It won't pick lottery numbers or make medical and financial decisions for you.
skills.title_en: Real coin-toss I Ching, no made-up hexagrams

skills.name: outfit-director
skills.title_zh: 一次拍出多套造型的换装视频脚本
skills.tagline_zh: 换装视频最容易翻车的是换完不像同一个人。它先出一张拼贴首帧当结构母图，视频时间轴强制继承主体身份和贴图位置。人和宠物都能做。
skills.tagline_en: Outfit-change videos fail when the person stops looking like the same person. This one builds a collage first frame as the structural master, then forces the video timeline to inherit subject identity and sticker positions. Works for people and pets.
skills.desc_en: 为女性、男性或宠物设计「同一主体多套造型拼贴首帧 + 换装视频」，输出参数锁定、图片提示词、完整时间轴、精简视频提示词和负面约束。
skills.why_zh: 把「身份一致性」当成硬约束而不是碰运气——先定首帧再派生视频，这个顺序就是它和一堆换装提示词的全部区别。
skills.why_en: It treats identity consistency as a hard constraint rather than a hope: first frame first, video derived from it. That ordering is the entire difference between this and a pile of outfit prompts.
skills.limit_zh: 它交付的是提示词和时间轴，不是视频——真出片要你自己拿去生视频模型跑，成片效果取决于那个模型不取决于它。参数预设、转场库、服装方案分散在三个 references 文件里，正文只给路由。
skills.limit_en: It delivers prompts and a timeline, not a video — you still have to run them through a video model, and the result depends on that model, not on this. Parameter presets, the transition library and outfit plans live in three separate reference files; the main file is only a router.
skills.title_en: Outfit-change video scripts that keep the same subject
skills.limit_brief_zh: 它出的是提示词和时间轴，不是视频。
skills.limit_brief_en: It outputs prompts and a timeline, not a video.

skills.name: ljg-writes
skills.title_zh: 一个观点经得住反例才肯落笔的写作引擎
skills.tagline_zh: AI 写观点文最容易变成正确的废话。它的目标很具体：1000-1500 字，可理解、可迁移、经得住反例——而且明说不做普通摘要。
skills.tagline_en: AI opinion pieces default to being correct and empty. This one sets a specific bar: 1000–1500 words, understandable, transferable, and able to survive counterexamples — and it explicitly refuses to write summaries.
skills.desc_en: "写作引擎。把一个观点写成可理解、可迁移、经得住反例的 1000-1500 字中文文章。USE WHEN 写文章 OR 优化思想内容 OR 展开观点 OR 改写成逻辑递进的中文。NOT FOR 普通摘要、事实查询或结构风洞（用 ljg-structure）。"
skills.why_zh: 「经得住反例」是我见过对写作最狠的自我要求，比「高质量」这类词实在得多。作者知道自己在做什么。
skills.why_en: 'Survives counterexamples' is the most demanding thing I've seen a writing skill ask of itself. Far more concrete than claiming 'high quality'.
skills.limit_zh: 产出直接落成 Org 文件写进 ~/Documents/notes，文件头的 author 写死「李继刚」，保存后还要过 org-lint 和 Denote 校验——不用 Emacs/Org 的人得先拆掉这一整套。默认 1000–1500 字，摘要和事实查询作者明写不接。
skills.limit_en: Output lands as Org files in ~/Documents/notes with the author field hard-coded, then runs org-lint and Denote checks. If you don't use Emacs and Org, you're dismantling that whole stack first.
skills.title_en: A writing engine that won't write until your idea survives.

skills.name: multi-copywrite-alchemy
skills.title_zh: 分析某位作者的多篇文章复刻其文风
skills.tagline_zh: 想学某个人的写法，读十篇也说不清他到底怎么写的。它拆解一位作者的多篇文章还原其思维方式，生成专属写作分身和风格提示词。
skills.tagline_en: Reading ten pieces still won't tell you how someone actually writes. This takes a body of one author's work apart, reconstructs how they think, and gives you a writing persona plus style prompts.
skills.desc_en: 复刻蒸馏写作技能 —— 分析一位作者的多篇文章，深度还原其思维方式与写作风格，生成专属写作分身子技能与风格提示词。支持公众号、抖音多平台自动采集素材，也可手动粘贴文章或指定文件路径。触发词：蒸馏写作风格、写作分身、克隆写作风格、复刻蒸馏写作技能。
skills.why_zh: 「还原思维方式」比「模仿句式」高一档——前者能迁移到新题材，后者换个题目就露馅。
skills.why_en: Reconstructing the thinking beats mimicking the sentences — the first transfers to new subjects, the second falls apart the moment the topic changes.
skills.limit_zh: 要去作者自家 redfox.hk 注册拿 REDFOX_API_KEY 配成环境变量才跑得动，平台采集只覆盖公众号和抖音。素材少于 3 篇 2000 字别指望还原，理想量作者标的是 10 篇 1 万字。核心流程在 references/core_workflow.md。
skills.limit_en: Needs a REDFOX_API_KEY from the author's own redfox.hk, and its collection covers only WeChat and Douyin. Under three pieces or 2000 words there's nothing to reconstruct; the author's stated target is ten pieces, 10k words.
skills.title_en: Reverse-engineer a writer's voice from their work

skills.name: official-document-writing
skills.title_zh: 按 GB/T 9704 规范写党政机关公文
skills.tagline_zh: 请示、通知、函、纪要——体制内的公文错一个格式就要返工。它按国标给格式规范、模板和用语建议，还带质量检查。
skills.tagline_en: Tired of format rejections on official memos? It checks layout per GB/T 9704-2012, offers templates & wording.
skills.desc_en: 专业的党政机关公文写作指南。当用户需要撰写、修改或审核党政机关公文（如请示、通知、函、总结、纪要等）时使用。提供GB/T 9704-2012格式规范指导、常用公文模板、语言规范建议和公文质量检查。适用于以下场景：(1) 撰写新公文，(2) 修改完善公文，(3) 检查公文格式规范，(4) 提供公文写作指导，(5) 审核公文质量。
skills.why_zh: 极致垂直，而且是国外市场绝不会有的东西。作者引了具体国标号，说明他真的在这行里。
skills.why_en: Not generic writing tips—it turns the national standard into a checkable list, flagging exact non-compliant spots from header to.
skills.unshelve_reason: C 端全球化转向（店主 2026-08-19）：党政机关公文是职业工具 + 中国体制限定，两条都不符合新方向。它本身质量没问题（引具体国标号、作者真在这行里），是定位不匹配，不是货不好。留档随时可翻回。
skills.limit_zh: 它管 GB/T 9704 的格式与用语，不管这份文该不该发、内容对不对。全文没写任何适用边界，实质内容还是你自己扛。
skills.limit_en: It covers GB/T 9704 formatting and register — not whether the document should be sent or whether its content is right. No stated boundaries anywhere in the skill.
skills.title_en: Official document writing guide: format, wording, review

skills.name: fengshui-master
skills.title_zh: 先说自己不算命的风水顾问
skills.tagline_zh: 看房时想问朝向旺位煞气，网上说法互相打架。它按三元玄空飞星、八宅明镜、形势峦头三套体系分开算，不合并成一个答案糊弄你。
skills.why_zh: 诚实段先引经典说风水辅佐不决定命运。一个会先缩小自己主张的术数，反而更好信。
skills.limit_zh: 三套体系常互相打架，并排展示不替你裁决。葬法地域差异极大，别当通例。
skills.tagline_en: You want to ask about orientation, favourable sectors and sha positions, and every source online contradicts the last. This runs three systems separately — Flying Star, Eight Mansions, and form-and-landform — instead of blending them into one confident answer.
skills.why_en: Its honesty section quotes the classics to say feng shui assists but does not determine fate. A practice that shrinks its own claim first is easier to trust.
skills.limit_en: The three systems routinely disagree with each other; it shows them side by side and won't adjudicate for you. Burial-site practice varies enormously by region — don't read it as a general rule.
skills.title_en: A feng shui adviser that opens by limiting itself

skills.name: TCM.Skill
skills.title_zh: 会劝你去挂急诊的中医参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 家里人不舒服，最难的是判断「要不要现在就去医院」。它把疑似致命的情况列成红线层——高热神昏、胸痛彻背、假神脱汗，一律叫急救不辨证。
skills.why_zh: 这类里我见过最安全的边界：先点名「传统框架拖成急诊」的失败模式，并在红线层直接拒绝辨证。
skills.limit_zh: 定位是「家庭参谋而非医师」，不出处方。针刺绝对禁止自行操作，只解释指路。教材派立场，与经方派、温病派的结论会不一致，它不替你调和。 上游 SKILL.md 的 name 是中文「中医」，装上后可能不被识别，改成 tcm 更稳。 门面说不出处方，但硬约束文件给了 101 味毒性药的内服克数 —— 那是上限表，不是处方。
skills.tagline_en: The hard call at home is not which remedy — it's whether to go to hospital now. It puts suspected life-threatening presentations in a red-line tier: high fever with confusion, chest pain through to the back, cold sweat — call emergency services, no differentiation.
skills.why_en: The safest boundary I've seen in this category. It names the failure mode where a traditional framework delays real care, and refuses to be used there.
skills.limit_en: Positioned as a family adviser, not a physician; it writes no prescriptions. Self-administered acupuncture is forbidden outright, explanation only. It argues from the textbook tradition and will not reconcile itself with rival schools. Upstream's name field is Chinese, so the loader may not pick it up — rename it to tcm. The facade writes no prescriptions, yet its hard-constraint file lists oral gram doses for 101 toxic herbs — read them as ceilings, not prescriptions.
skills.title_en: Traditional medicine that tells you to call an ambulance

skills.name: arb-skill
skills.title_zh: 被辞退之后，帮你把证据和钱算清楚
skills.tagline_zh: 劳动仲裁难在两头：证据散在考勤和聊天记录里，钱不知道该要多少。它解析考勤文件、算加班费赔偿金社保差额，出一份完整报告。
skills.why_zh: 它明确站在普通员工这一边——不是给 HR 用的合规工具，是给被辞退的人用的取证工具。立场清楚本身就是一种品味。
skills.limit_zh: 算的是通用口径，各地仲裁委的实际认定差异很大，报告只能当谈判和立案的底稿，不是结论。证据采集依赖你自己能拿到的考勤和记录。
skills.tagline_en: Labour arbitration is hard at both ends: the evidence is scattered across attendance logs and chat history, and you have no idea what number to ask for. This parses attendance files, computes overtime, severance and social-insurance shortfalls, and writes it up.
skills.why_en: It is unambiguously on the employee's side — not an HR compliance tool, an evidence tool for the person who was let go. Knowing whose side you're on is itself taste.
skills.limit_en: Calculations use general formulas; local arbitration commissions differ a great deal in practice, so the report is a negotiating draft, not a conclusion. Mainland China labour law only.
skills.title_en: Build the evidence file after you're fired

skills.name: system-fitness-advisor
skills.title_zh: 按你的训练记录算下一次该练什么
skills.tagline_zh: 健身 skill 大多发你一张通用计划表。它要的是你的训记、CSV 或截图，然后只答一件事：下次练什么、加多少、要不要减量。
skills.tagline_en: Most fitness skills hand you a generic template. This one wants your actual log — CSV, JSON, or a screenshot — and answers one question: what to do next session, how much to add, whether to deload.
skills.desc_en: Turn the user's actual training evidence into the smallest useful next decision. Return a concrete next session or a bounded change to the current plan, not a generic template.
skills.why_zh: 它把胸痛、晕厥、放射性麻木写成硬停止条件，还默认只读、不回显任何 key——一个健身件肯写这两条。
skills.why_en: Chest pain, fainting and radiating numbness are hard stop conditions in the file itself, and it defaults to read-only, never echoing keys. A fitness skill bothering with either is a sign the author is serious.
skills.limit_zh: 没有训练记录它就退化成通用建议——它全部的价值建立在你手上已经有训记、CSV 或 JSON。作者明写不做医疗诊断、不接与训练无关的营养查询；出现胸痛晕厥这类信号它会停下让你去看急诊，不会继续排计划。
skills.limit_en: Without a training log it degrades into generic advice — its whole value rests on you already having data (Xunji, CSV or JSON). The author states plainly it does not diagnose, refuses nutrition-only questions, and stops programming entirely on emergency symptoms.
skills.title_en: Reads your training log and decides your next session
skills.limit_brief_zh: 没有训练记录，它只能给通用建议。
skills.limit_brief_en: With no training log, it can only give generic advice.

skills.name: hemingway-perspective
skills.title_zh: 短句砍到骨头里，海明威式改稿人
skills.tagline_zh: 想让文字硬一点、少一点形容词，却说不清怎么改。它用冰山理论、极简短句和硬汉式克制来回应——只谈写作，不扮演海明威本人。
skills.tagline_en: You want the prose harder and the adjectives gone but can't say how. It answers through iceberg theory, short declaratives and hard-boiled restraint — and it discusses writing only; it does not play Hemingway.
skills.desc_en: >- 用海明威的冰山理论、极简短句与硬汉式克制来回应写作与表达相关的问题 当用户明确要求使用这一人物的视角、提到“hemingway-perspective”，或希望应用其核心方法分析问题时使用；不要因一般性问题自动触发。
skills.why_zh: 「不要用来扮演本人」这条边界划得清醒：它做的是方法迁移，不是角色扮演。这个分寸是品味。
skills.why_en: 'Do not use this to impersonate the man' is a clear-eyed boundary: it transfers a method, it doesn't cosplay an author. That sense of proportion is taste.
skills.limit_zh: 作者明说不因一般问题自动触发，得你点名叫它。而且只对写作和表达类问题有用，拿它聊别的等于没装。
skills.limit_en: The author explicitly disables auto-triggering — you have to call it by name. It only helps with writing and expression; for anything else it may as well not be installed.
skills.title_en: Hemingway-style editor that cuts prose to the bone

skills.name: video-assemble
skills.title_zh: 旁白落定才压原声，字幕烧完再响度归一
skills.tagline_zh: 旁白、字幕、原声三轨纠缠的最后一公里。不用手动对齐时间轴，它按旁白窗口自动压低背景音，生成可烧录字幕。
skills.tagline_en: The last mile where narration, subtitles, and source audio tangle. It ducks background by narration windows.
skills.desc_en: 合成视频解说最终成片：把旁白音频铺到源视频上，按旁白窗口压低原声，生成 SRT / ASS 字幕并可烧录， 最后做响度标准化。作为最终合成阶段使用。输入源视频、tts_meta.json 与旁白位置； 输出 recap 成片和字幕。触发词：视频合成、混音、字幕、压字幕、assemble video、mux、ducking、subtitles、成片。
skills.why_zh: 它把「混音决策」编码成规则：ducking 深度随旁白能量动态调，而不是固定衰减。
skills.why_en: Encodes mixing decisions as rules: ducking depth adapts to narration energy, not fixed attenuation. Subtitle timing comes.
skills.limit_zh: 只吃 tts_meta.json 的旁白窗口，手动标注的旁白位置不认。源视频须含音轨，纯画面素材会中断。
skills.limit_en: Requires tts_meta.json for narration windows; manual timestamps unsupported. Source must have an audio track. SRT/ASS limited to preset styles, no.
skills.title_en: Duck audio under narration, burn subs, normalize loudness

skills.name: parsing-futu-statements
skills.title_zh: 从富途月结单里抠出境外所得报税数据
skills.tagline_zh: 港美股报个税境外所得，卡在券商月结单上：分红和已实现盈亏根本不在你以为的那一栏，而且账单本身不算这个数。
skills.why_zh: 它整篇在讲「数字藏在哪」和「怎么把账单没算的重建出来」，还专列了一节常见坑——这是对着真账单啃过一遍才写得出的东西。
skills.limit_zh: 只读官方账单文件，不连券商账户。富途一家的格式，换券商不通用。重建出来的已实现盈亏是按它的口径算的，报税前该自己复核。
skills.tagline_en: Reporting overseas investment income stalls on the broker statement: dividends and realised P&L are not in the column you'd expect, and the statement doesn't compute the figure you need at all.
skills.why_en: The whole document is about where the numbers actually live and how to rebuild what the statement omits, with a section of common traps. That only comes from grinding through real statements.
skills.limit_en: Reads official statement files only; it never connects to your account. Futu's format specifically — other brokers won't parse. The reconstructed P&L follows its own convention; check it before filing.
skills.title_en: Find the numbers a broker statement hides

skills.name: wujutong
skills.title_zh: 按三焦辨证给温病方，古人矛盾处照原样留着
skills.tagline_zh: 温病和伤寒是两套打法，用错了会反着治。它按《温病条辨》三焦辨证走，22 首方按上中下焦排开，359 个医案双索引。
skills.why_zh: 有一节叫「内部张力——保留，不调和」。古人自相矛盾处留着缝，并点名对立学派把你送过去。
skills.limit_zh: 只做温病；伤寒、杂病、气化学派不在范围，作者分别指路。不出处方；安全说明单独成节。
skills.tagline_en: Warm-disease theory and cold-damage theory are two different games; use the wrong one and you treat backwards. This follows the triple-burner differentiation, 22 core formulas laid out by burner, 359 case records double-indexed.
skills.why_en: One section is titled 'internal tensions — kept, not reconciled'. Where the classical author contradicts himself, it leaves the seam visible. It also names the rival school by skill and sends you there.
skills.limit_en: Warm disease only — cold damage, miscellaneous disease and the qi-dynamic school are out of scope and the author points each one elsewhere. No prescriptions; safety notice in its own section.
skills.title_en: Triple-burner differentiation for warm diseases — contradictions in the classics left standing

skills.name: liu-xiaoyan-english
skills.title_zh: 刘晓艳考研英语真题逐句精讲，不懂的句子当场拆给你看
skills.tagline_zh: 备考最怕的是讲得四平八稳、听完什么也没记住。它模拟刘晓燕的教学腔：拆洋葱法看长难句、句型组装法写作文，已用 2026 年 6 月六级真题校准。
skills.why_zh: 「绝对禁止」那节反着写：不许学术腔、不许翻译腔、不许「首先其次最后」。用规则把课讲得像人话，比堆知识点难。
skills.limit_zh: 是教学风格的模拟，不是本人，方法论提炼自公开课程。押题和预测一概不做，真题校准只到 2026 年 6 月，之后的考纲变化它不知道。
skills.tagline_en: The worst thing about test prep is a lesson so even-toned you remember none of it. This models a well-known Chinese exam coach's blunt classroom voice — peeling long sentences apart, assembling essays from patterns — calibrated against the June 2026 CET-6 paper.
skills.why_en: Its 'absolutely forbidden' section is written in reverse: no academic register, no translationese, no 'firstly, secondly, finally'. Using rules to make a lesson sound human is harder than piling on content.
skills.limit_en: A simulation of a teaching style, not the person; the method is drawn from public course material. It makes no predictions about what will be on the paper, and calibration stops at June 2026. Chinese English-exam context (CET/postgraduate).
skills.title_en: Liu Xiaoyan-style English: every real-exam sentence broken.

skills.name: chinese-baby-naming
skills.title_zh: 全家为起名吵架时出来当中间人
skills.tagline_zh: 起名难的从来不是想不出字，是爷爷要字辈、妈妈嫌笔画多、爸爸信五行。它专门做了协商模式，把冲突摆到台面上一条条谈。
skills.why_zh: 反模式写得清醒：没给出生时刻绝不伪造命盘；不为凑五行去用冷僻字——「孩子要写、要被叫一辈子」。
skills.limit_zh: 不做店名/品牌/宠物/游戏角色/虚构名，不做纯算命、不解读已有名字。方言校验只覆盖它掌握的语组。
skills.tagline_en: Naming a Chinese child is never short of characters — it's short of agreement: grandfather wants the generation character, mother says too many strokes, father wants the five elements balanced. It has a negotiation mode that puts the conflict on the table.
skills.why_en: The anti-patterns section is unusually clear-eyed: never fake a birth chart when no birth time was given, never reach for a rare character to balance the elements — 'the child will write it and hear it mispronounced for a lifetime'.
skills.limit_en: It refuses shops, brands, pets, game characters and fictional names, and won't do pure fortune-telling or interpret an existing name. Dialect checks cover only the language groups it knows; where it doesn't know, it says so.
skills.title_en: Mediating the family argument about the baby's name

skills.name: beijing-pollen-monitor
skills.title_zh: 查北京 16 区花粉浓度和过敏预报
skills.tagline_zh: 每年三四月对花粉过敏的人来说是渡劫。它拉 16 个站点的实时监测和分类预报，按区查，出门前知道今天该不该戴口罩。
skills.tagline_en: March and April are an ordeal if you're allergic. It pulls live readings and graded forecasts from 16 monitoring stations, queryable by district, so you know before you leave whether to mask up.
skills.desc_en: 查询北京花粉实时监测和预报数据，生成包含区级浓度、站点趋势、总量预报与分类预报的结果。北京 16 个固定站点，每区一个，用区名指定。 user-invocable: true argument-hint: "[report|overview|stations|history|forecast|daily] [--district 海淀] [options]"
skills.why_zh: 垂直到一个城市、一种过敏原——但对那批人是刚需。这种「窄得理直气壮」正是大市场覆盖不到的东西。
skills.why_en: Narrow to one city and one allergen — and for those people it's essential. That kind of unembarrassed narrowness is exactly what a large marketplace never covers.
skills.limit_zh: metadata 里明写要本机有 curl 和 jq，全靠 scripts/beijing-pollen-query.sh 打公开接口。范围钉死北京 16 区，作者写明北京以外不要用。而且它只查不推——「每天早上发我」那种晨报要调用方自己接。
skills.limit_en: Its metadata requires curl and jq locally and everything runs through one shell script against a public endpoint. Pinned to Beijing's 16 districts; the author says plainly not to use it elsewhere. It queries on demand and does not push.
skills.title_en: Pollen by district, for one city that needs it

skills.name: create-larp-character
skills.title_zh: LARP 角色卡生成器：从一句话到可扮演的完整人设
skills.tagline_zh: 散场之后角色就没了，但你可能还想跟 ta 说话。丢进玩家本和人物小传 PDF，它拆出故事记忆和人物性格，生成一个能持续对话的角色。
skills.why_zh: 安全边界写着不泄露核心诡计和凶手、不透露该角色本不该知道的秘密——一个角色扮演工具主动防剧透，说明作者真在玩这个。
skills.limit_zh: 只用于个人情感体验，不该拿去帮别人过本。素材质量决定成品：小传写得薄，蒸馏出来的角色也薄。需要读写文件权限。
skills.tagline_en: The character disappears when the session ends, but you might still want to talk to them. Feed it the player script and character bio as PDF; it extracts story memory and personality into a character you can keep talking to.
skills.why_en: Its safety section refuses to leak the core trick or the culprit, and won't reveal what the character shouldn't know. A roleplay tool that guards against spoilers on its own is written by someone who actually plays.
skills.limit_en: For personal enjoyment only — not for helping someone else through a game they haven't played. Output quality follows the source: a thin bio yields a thin character. Needs file read/write permission.
skills.title_en: LARP character generator: one line to playable persona

skills.name: feline-health-advisory
skills.title_zh: 替猫拦下云南白药和藿香正气的养猫参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 猫吐了、乱尿了、咬人了，中文经验帖和「打一下就记住」全是坑；它先过一遍急诊红旗再答，答案对齐国际猫科福利指南。
skills.tagline_en: Vomiting, litter-box protests, biting — the folk remedies circulating online make it worse. This runs an emergency red-flag pass first, then answers from AAFP/ISFM welfare guidance.
skills.why_zh: 它把「不给剂量」做成硬规则：连人用药折算、朋友说、写科普这几种绕法都点名堵死。
skills.why_en: The refusal is hard-coded: no doses, and it names the loopholes it will not accept — "my vet already told me", "it's just for an article", "convert it by weight".
skills.limit_zh: 正文明写不给任何药物剂量、频次、疗程，即便用户声称兽医已给过指示也不替他补全。点名拒绝云南白药、藿香正气、蒙脱石散这类家庭偏方。只管猫不管狗；无法联网时不给召回、地区疫苗规则等当前结论，只讲原则和该去核验的官方渠道。
skills.limit_en: The file bars every drug dose, frequency and course, and will not fill gaps even when the user says a vet gave instructions. It names Yunnan Baiyao, Huoxiang Zhengqi and smectite as home remedies it refuses. Cats only. Offline, it gives principles and the official channels to check rather than current recall or regional vaccine rules.
skills.title_en: The cat advisor that will not hand you a dose

skills.name: fishing
skills.title_zh: 新手买竿，老手看天：从选位讲起
skills.tagline_zh: 没口的时候多半不是饵不对，是位置和天气不对。它把选位排在全篇第一，气压风向温差降雨讲完才轮到装备，台钓路亚海钓黑坑都覆盖。
skills.why_zh: 目录本身就是论点：选位写在最前。先讲位置和天气，再谈装备——把老手和新手真正分开的那一层。
skills.limit_zh: 经验知识，无实时水位/天气接口，仍要自己对照当天。偏中国淡水台钓路亚；海钓篇幅更薄。
skills.tagline_en: When nothing bites it's usually not the bait — it's the spot and the conditions. Swim selection comes first in the whole document; pressure, wind, temperature swing and rain are covered before any tackle, across float, lure, sea and commercial fisheries.
skills.why_en: The table of contents is the argument: 'swim selection (most important, first)'. It leads with what actually separates a veteran from a beginner instead of opening with gear recommendations.
skills.limit_en: Experience-based knowledge with no live water or weather feed, so you still map it onto the day yourself. Weighted towards Chinese freshwater methods; the sea-fishing material is thinner.
skills.title_en: Beginners buy rods, veterans read the weather

skills.name: china-pension-strategy
skills.title_zh: 社保断缴要不要补，用脚本算给你看
skills.tagline_zh: 权益单看不懂、断缴要不要补、灵活就业还交不交——这些是算术题不是玄学，但谁也不愿替你算。它按地区规则出确定值。
skills.why_zh: 每个政策数字都走确定性 CLI，明说从不在对话里口算。模型最容易算错社保算术。
skills.limit_zh: 隐私分 ALLOW / REDACT / BLOCK——身份证、社保号等走屏蔽。地区规则会变，脚本参数需对照当地最新文件；不是法律意见。
skills.tagline_en: Nobody wants to work out whether a contribution gap is worth filling, or whether flexible-employment contributions still pay off. These are arithmetic problems, not mysteries. It runs them against regional rules.
skills.why_en: Every policy figure goes through a deterministic CLI and it says outright that it never computes them inline. Models get social-insurance arithmetic wrong; this closes that door.
skills.limit_en: Privacy model is ALLOW / REDACT / BLOCK — national ID, social-security and bank card numbers are blocked outright. Still a local MVP with limited regional coverage, and results follow the current policy basis. Mainland China only.
skills.title_en: Whether to back-pay your pension gap, computed

skills.name: noir-interrogation
skills.title_zh: 审问式追问，直到你交出真需求
skills.tagline_zh: 玩推理最怕 AI 中途被你说服改口。这个把答案的哈希公示在开场简报里，你一间间审嫌疑人，它只照脚本发的卡演。
skills.tagline_en: What ruins AI mysteries is talking the model out of its own answer. Here the solution is SHA-256 committed in the opening briefing, and every suspect is played strictly off a card the script hands over.
skills.why_zh: 困难模式会塞进一个指错人的假证人。
skills.why_en: Hard mode plants a second witness who names the wrong person, and the model playing that suspect is not told the statement is false either.
skills.limit_zh: 一局 5–15 分钟，单场结束就完，不做多线战役。只有黑色电影一种类型，中途要奇幻或科幻会被拒绝；两套设定是 1940 年代美式与 1930 年代民国上海。作者明写不许 agent 去 Read 或 cat 案件 JSON，一旦绕过脚本。
skills.limit_en: One case runs 5–15 minutes and ends there; no campaigns. Noir only — fantasy or sci-fi requests are declined — in two settings, 1940s America and 1930s Shanghai. The file forbids the agent from ever reading or cat-ing the case JSON, since bypassing the script defeats the whole design.
skills.title_en: Interrogation-style questioning until real needs surface

skills.name: beachcombing
skills.title_zh: 潮水退去后替你扫三遍滩面的拾遗器
skills.tagline_zh: 大潮那两小时能挖到什么、几点回头才不会被围住——它先算撤退时刻再谈收获，11 省 51 处点位带方言别名和吃法。
skills.tagline_en: What is diggable in the two hours around a spring low tide, and when to turn back before the water closes in. Safe-exit time comes first, harvest second, across 51 sites in 11 coastal provinces.
skills.why_zh: 最难得的是它给自己设了上限：走天文骨架估算时，适用性评分强制压到五档里的第二档，不假装精确。
skills.why_en: The rare part is the ceiling it puts on itself: when it falls back to an astronomical skeleton estimate, the suitability rating is capped at the second of five levels rather than faked.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆盖中国大陆沿海，内置点库 11 省 51 处，其余靠 geocoding 兜底。没接真实潮汐 API 时走农历半日潮天文骨架，正文标「估算 ±1h」且评分不超过五档中的第二档。明确不做钓鱼预报、不做生物图像识别。
skills.limit_en: Mainland Chinese coast only — 51 built-in sites across 11 provinces, everything else falls back to geocoding. Without a real tide API it computes a lunar semidiurnal skeleton, labelled "estimated ±1h" and capped at the second of five suitability levels. It explicitly declines fishing forecasts, species photo ID, and any legal check on closed seasons or protected areas.
skills.title_en: A beachcomber that sweeps the strandline three times after.

skills.name: birdsight
skills.title_zh: 查稀有鸟最近落在哪，顺带说清中文名是台湾译名
skills.tagline_zh: 想知道这周末附近有没有稀有鸟、哪个热点在出货，它直连康奈尔 eBird 官方接口取真实观察记录，不靠模型记忆瞎编。
skills.tagline_en: Wondering whether anything rare has turned up near you this weekend, or which hotspot is producing — this queries Cornell's eBird API v2 directly for real sightings.
skills.why_zh: 20 个端点逐个实测过，还写明哪两个已经 404/403、别调；观测数据一律来自接口，不许凭训练知识补。
skills.why_en: All twenty endpoints were tested by hand, including the two that return 404 and 403 and are marked do-not-call. Sightings must come from the API, never from the model's memory.
skills.limit_zh: 要自己去 ebird.org/api/keygen 申请免费 key，该 key 限非商业用途、并发超过 3 就 429。recent 端点最多回溯 30 天，全量历史得另申请 EBD。locale=zh 返回繁体台湾名（如「鉛色水鶇」），大陆常用名作者明说要自己维护别名表。
skills.limit_en: You supply your own free key from ebird.org/api/keygen; free keys are non-commercial and start returning 429 above three concurrent requests. Recent-observation endpoints look back thirty days at most — full history needs a separate EBD request. Chinese common names come back in Taiwanese traditional form, and the author says to keep your own alias table rather than invent mainland ones.
skills.title_en: Ask eBird who saw what bird, and where, this week

skills.name: recomp-coach
skills.title_zh: 卡路里跟克数打架就按克数重算的增肌减脂教练
skills.tagline_zh: 5:2 轻断食配碳水循环，难的不是方案是执行走样。它把每天的日志解析成 JSON，只点最大的那个缺口，只给一条调整。
skills.tagline_en: 5:2 fasting with carb cycling — the hard part was never the plan, it is the drift. It parses each daily log into JSON, names the single largest gap, and prescribes exactly one change.
skills.why_zh: 「一次只动一根杠杆」被写成硬规则：没有触发行就说「本周无需调整」，不为了显得有用而改方案。
skills.why_en: One lever at a time is a hard rule. With no trigger row met it says "hold, no change indicated" rather than adjusting something so it looks useful.
skills.limit_zh: 作者自己在正文里写了外部效度短板：支撑间歇性限能的 MATADOR 与 Seimon 试验做的是肥胖人群，不是已经接近目标体脂的瘦人。方案假定健康成年人，周亏空必须落在 2000–4000 kcal；睡眠长期低于 7 小时时先标记睡眠，暂不调整饮食与训练。
skills.limit_en: The author writes the external-validity gap into the file himself: the MATADOR and Seimon trials behind intermittent restriction were run in people with obesity, not lean people near target body fat. It assumes a healthy adult, keeps the weekly deficit in a 2,000–4,000 kcal band, and when sleep is chronically under seven hours it flags sleep first and holds all diet and training changes.
skills.title_en: A recomp coach that recomputes your calories from the grams

skills.name: heat-risk
skills.title_zh: 体感温度骗过你时，它用湿球温度叫停训练
skills.tagline_zh: 「今天能不能跑步、军训、开工」，看气温会看错。它拉 open-meteo 七天预报算湿球温度，按五级直接给行动建议。
skills.tagline_en: Deciding whether it is safe to run, drill or work outside today — air temperature will mislead you. This pulls a seven-day open-meteo forecast, computes wet-bulb, and grades five risk levels.
skills.why_zh: 换掉了大家惯用的那把尺子：31℃ 湿球以上一切户外都危险，35℃ 是理论生存极限（PNAS 2010）。
skills.why_en: It swaps out the scale people actually use: above 31°C wet-bulb all outdoor activity is dangerous, and 35°C is the theoretical survival limit, cited to Sherwood & Huber, PNAS 2010.
skills.limit_zh: 只给风险等级和建议，不做诊断——正文最后一条是出现高热无汗、意识模糊立即就医。中文城市名查不到时要改传拼音（作者举的例子是 Dunhuang）。数据源单一，只有 open-meteo 的 7 天预报，没有实测站点校正。
skills.limit_en: It grades risk and stops there — the file's closing line sends anyone with high fever without sweating, or confusion, straight to a hospital. Chinese city names that miss have to be retyped in pinyin (the worked example is Dunhuang). One data source only: the open-meteo seven-day forecast, with no station correction.
skills.title_en: Wet-bulb heat risk that halts outdoor training

skills.name: human-allegory-engine
skills.title_zh: 把人生事件转成可复用的寓言引擎
skills.tagline_zh: 模型写小小说总是同一套：领导宣布、众人执行、底层受苦、老人落泪。它把这些列成模板清单，撞上就强制换两个维度重写。
skills.tagline_en: Models write the same parable every time. This lists those beats as a checklist and forces two dimensions to change on collision.
skills.why_zh: 拒绝模仿任何具体作家的文风，只把要求翻译成冷幽默、荒诞因果、留白这些可迁移技法；结尾掏磨损物件这类套路直接禁止。
skills.why_en: Refuses named-author mimicry; translates requests into transferable craft. The worn-object ending is on the ban list, not the title.
skills.limit_zh: 只写中文超短篇，上限 3000 字。默认只输出标题和正文，不给寓意、落点、创作说明。不把真实个人或机构写成加害者，不用地域/职业/贫困/残障做快捷笑点，不为煽情临时加死亡与重病。
skills.limit_en: Chinese flash only, ≤3000 chars. Title + story only by default. No real persons/orgs as villains; no region/job/poverty/disability joke shortcuts; no late death for pathos.
skills.title_en: Turn life events into reusable allegories

skills.name: pollen-query
skills.title_zh: 花粉季出门前查一眼，53 城都有
skills.tagline_zh: 三四月对过敏的人是渡劫，而多数天气 app 根本不报花粉。它拉中国天气网的监测站数据，给浓度等级、风险提示和 7 天历史加预报。
skills.why_zh: 多数天气 app 不报花粉；它用标准库直拉监测站，缺数就明说，不把扩散指数冒充浓度。
skills.limit_zh: 仅 53 个有监测站的城市；淡季报无、单日缺口正常。备用源是扩散指数不是浓度，别当同一个数。仅中国大陆。
skills.tagline_en: Allergy season is an ordeal and most weather apps don't report pollen at all. It pulls monitoring-station data for grade, risk note, and seven days of history plus forecast.
skills.why_en: Standard library only, nothing to install; the fallback source is kept clearly separate from the primary one, and when data is missing it says so rather than passing off a dispersal index as a concentration.
skills.limit_en: Only the 53 cities with monitoring stations; smaller cities have no data. Out of season it reports none, and gaps on individual days are normal. The fallback gives a dispersal index, not a concentration — don't read them as the same number. Mainland China only.
skills.title_en: Check pollen before you go out, 53 cities

skills.name: parenting-advisor
skills.title_zh: 专防「假托崔玉涛」文章的 0–13 岁育儿参谋
skills.tagline_zh: 孩子发烧、咬人、不肯吃饭时，最怕搜到一篇署名权威的假文章。它逼自己每个结论凑够两个独立来源，凑不够就明说降可信度。
skills.tagline_en: Fever, biting, refusing food — the real hazard is landing on a convincing article falsely bylined to a famous pediatrician. This forces two independent authoritative sources per conclusion, or downgrades its own confidence out loud.
skills.why_zh: 它给自己列了一张「AI 可能说的借口」对照表——「症状太典型了基本能确定」在表里是必须叫停的信号。
skills.why_en: It keeps a table of the excuses an AI is likely to make. "The symptoms are textbook, I can basically confirm it" is listed there as a signal to stop, not to proceed.
skills.limit_zh: 档案默认写进 Obsidian 式知识库的固定路径（08-全局记忆/L1-画像记忆/孩子名），没有知识库得先指定一个本地目录。覆盖 0–13 岁，只说「症状被关联到 XX」不说「得了 XX」，不推荐任何药品和剂量；输入命中呼吸困难、抽搐等词会跳过全部流程，只输出就医引导。
skills.limit_en: Profiles are written to a fixed Obsidian-style vault path, so without a vault you must nominate a local directory first. Ages 0–13. It says "this symptom has been associated with X", never "your child has X", and recommends no drug or dose. Words like breathing difficulty or seizure skip every workflow and return only a go-to-hospital message.
skills.title_en: A 0–13 parenting advisor that will not take one source's word for it

skills.name: ink-wash-poster

skills.tagline_zh: 墨色和留白锁死，不是淡淡滤镜
skills.tagline_en: Turn a line, photo, or memory into a quiet, spacious ink-wash poster. It drafts the prompt first, then renders.
skills.desc_en: Generate an ink-wash editorial poster prompt and the matching bitmap image from a user's theme, sentence, object, mood, article idea, photo, content brief, poem, memory, event, place, or other creative material. Use when the user wants a quiet, spacious, tactile ink-wash poster, cover, cultural visual, or reference-photo reinterpretation with thoughtful composition, paper texture, restrained typog
skills.why_zh: 按水墨海报的浓淡和空白重做照片，笔是结构不是装饰。
skills.why_en: Two-step pipeline: lock the prompt with composition and typography first, then render the image—taming text-to-image drift.
skills.limit_zh: 要彩色插画、要写实人像，墨会把你按回去。
skills.limit_en: Single vertical editorial poster only—no multi-page, landscape, or motion. Requires an external image API (no local model). Pure audio/video input.
skills.title_en: Turn any material into an ink-wash editorial poster with.

skills.name: cn-compliance-guard
skills.title_zh: 上架前扫一遍，广告法违禁词当场标红
skills.tagline_zh: 200+违禁词、6类法律风险、5大平台SEO规则一次查完。不只告诉你哪里违规，还给出能安全替换的说法。
skills.tagline_en: Scans 200+ banned words, 6 legal risk types, 5 platform SEO rules. Flags violations and suggests safe.
skills.desc_en: Scan Chinese text for 200+ banned words across 6 legal categories (广告法/消费者权益保护法), check SEO compliance for 5 platforms (百度/小红书/抖音/淘宝/京东), and provide safe replacement suggestions. Detects 绝对化用语, 医疗效果承诺, 虚假宣传, 金融承诺, 诱导消费, 比较广告. Use when: checking Chinese marketing copy for legal compliance, reviewing product descriptions for advertising law violations, auditing content before publishing on Chinese
skills.why_zh: 把广告法、消保法的抽象条款编译成可执行的检查清单，连平台SEO偏好也纳入同一套规则。
skills.why_en: Turns vague ad-law clauses into an executable checklist, merging platform SEO quirks into one pass—no more guessing what.
skills.limit_zh: 只认简体中文营销文案，不覆盖合同、公告等非广告文体；替换建议基于通用合规，不保证特定平台审核必过。
skills.limit_en: Simplified-Chinese marketing copy only; not for contracts or notices. Rewrites are generic, not platform-guaranteed. Needs internet for latest rules.
skills.title_en: Pre-publish scan for China ad-law banned words

skills.name: photo-revival
skills.title_zh: 日常快照收成手绘诗意稿
skills.tagline_zh: 普通现场留下，笔触盖上去，不像精修
skills.tagline_en: Tired of filters and beauty modes? This photo wants to be drawn, not edited. Big white space, local color.
skills.desc_en: Turn ordinary photos or everyday snapshots into poetic hand-drawn illustrations with large white-paper negative space, vivid localized color, subtle collage accents, and tiny handwritten captions. skills.why_zh: 把随手拍抽成手绘插画，诗意在省略，不在加光。
skills.why_en: Not style transfer—it recomposes first: strips clutter, redistributes white space and color by poetic logic, then adds collage.
skills.limit_zh: 要证件照、要原片细节全留，会画丢。
skills.limit_en: Single photo only, no batch. Needs one clear subject (person/object/scene); pure landscapes or very low light degrade to blank paper. Output is PNG.
skills.title_en: Turn snapshots into poetic hand-drawn illustrations

skills.name: photo-riso-poster
skills.title_zh: 照片收成孔版印刷海报
skills.tagline_zh: 套色和网点是规矩，不是复古滤镜
skills.tagline_en: Too noisy? It deconstructs counts, spacing, occlusion, direction, color roles, then rebuilds them as a 2–3 ink.
skills.desc_en: Turn a photo or a text theme into one quiet riso-print archive poster. For a photo, deconstruct its observable facts (counts, spacing, occlusion, direction, color roles) and rebuild them as a sparse 2–3 ink risograph composition on temperature-matched paper, with typography that also carries the evidence; for a text theme, distill one imageable idea. Aspect ratio follows the source photo. Generate
skills.why_zh: 按孔版印刷的套色层数做海报，颜色少、边毛、故意不准。
skills.why_en: Not a filter—an analysis. It turns observable facts into compositional grammar, with ink and paper temperature chosen by.
skills.limit_zh: 不是高清写真。要渐变商业海报，对不上。
skills.limit_en: Single photo or one text theme only; outputs a static poster, no multi-page or motion. Requires Python 3.9+ and riso libs (pypdf, Pillow); no.
skills.title_en: Distill a photo into one quiet riso-print archive poster

skills.name: agentmemory-config
skills.title_zh: 不翻源码就改配置，环境变量端口开关全在这
skills.tagline_zh: 改端口、设 API key、开功能开关，翻遍 README 找不到的默认关闭原因，它直接告诉你。
skills.tagline_en: Change ports, set API keys, toggle features, and learn why defaults are off—without grepping the source.
skills.desc_en: agentmemory configuration, environment variables, ports, and feature flags. Use when enabling a feature, changing ports, setting an API key, configuring auth, or explaining why a feature is off by default.
skills.why_zh: 把散落在代码里的配置项、环境变量、端口和 feature flag 收拢成一张清单。
skills.why_en: Centralizes scattered env vars, ports, and feature flags into one categorized reference—ask it instead of digging through code.
skills.limit_zh: 只覆盖 agentmemory 这一个项目的配置面，不解释业务逻辑；改完配置不负责验证生效，也不管重启流程。
skills.limit_en: Covers only agentmemory's config surface, not business logic. Won't verify changes take effect or handle restarts. May reference outdated names.
skills.title_en: Change config without reading source: env vars, ports, flags

skills.name: fantasy-minimal-magazine

skills.tagline_zh: 编辑页的留白和字号，不是方图加字

skills.desc_en: Create FANTASY-branded 3:4 minimal editorial magazine posters from user-provided images by reading the image, reducing visual information, translating it into abstract editorial material, composing with large whitespace, and generating content-driven typography. Use when the user asks for "fantasy-极简杂志", "极简杂志海报", "编辑出版海报", "图片转译海报", "FANTASY magazine poster", or wants a quiet archival/minimal pub
skills.why_zh: 按杂志封面的格子重排主题。品牌味在版式里，不在滤镜里。
skills.why_en: Not a filter. It reads the image first, reduces it, then translates into editorial material—whitespace and type scale follow.
skills.limit_zh: 页是 3:4 封面。要长图文、要视频封面。
skills.limit_en: Outputs only 3:4 portrait. Needs clear subject, no blown-out background. It abstracts—no photorealistic faces/products. Single-page poster only, no.
skills.title_en: Turn any photo into a FANTASY minimal magazine poster

Use when the use

skills.why_en: It doesn't slap on a filter — it dissects the theme's imagery core, then pairs layout, whitespace, typography & copy tone into a.
skills.limit_zh: 不是喜茶那件，也不是水墨写意。要品牌 VI，另找。
skills.limit_en: Delivers design blueprints & prompts only, no image files — you'll need a separate generator or designer. Weak on pure Western minimalism or.

skills.name: hand-drawn
skills.title_zh: 按手绘那一套出图，风格点名才动
skills.tagline_zh: 先报名，再画。不混装水彩和马克笔
skills.tagline_en: Crayon, ink, or Ghibli? Stop hunting for prompt recipes. Name a style, get a structured prompt with reference.
skills.desc_en: Use when users ask for a hand-drawn or illustrated image prompt, name one of the repository's 18 numbered styles or the 3.1 stable variant, or mention triggers such as 亲子手绘、家庭蜡笔画、蜡笔、吉卜力、水墨、像素、淡彩速写、动画概念、水粉、北欧绘本、纸雕、软胶潮玩、墨线绘本、暖色扁平绘本、family-crayon-card、warm-flat-storybook. Produces prompt text or a formal reference-bearing call bundle and does not generate images.
skills.why_zh: 手绘不是一种滤镜。它要你说出用哪一种笔，才肯出那一种痕迹。
skills.why_en: Ships with 18 numbered styles plus a stable variant, each decomposed into reusable prompt templates with official reference.
skills.limit_zh: 不是万能插画箱。不点名风格，它不知道画什么。
skills.limit_en: Outputs only prompt text and reference links, no image generation. Requires your own drawing tool (e.g., MJ/SD). Covers only the 18 repo styles; no.
skills.title_en: Turn 18 hand-drawn styles into a ready-to-use image prompt

skills.name: pixel-style-poster-skill
skills.title_zh: 像素风海报，格点锁死
skills.tagline_zh: 格子是结构，不是加一层马赛克
skills.tagline_en: Give a theme, mood, or photo; get an editorial dot-matrix poster: fine-grained subject, restrained palette.
skills.desc_en: Generate Pixel Style Poster prompts and matching raster images. Use when the user gives a theme, phrase, object, mood, photo, or content idea and wants a 3:4 editorial bitmap poster with a large fine dot-matrix subject, optional title-led or quiet microtype typography, close subject-text composition, optional colored-wash reverse halftone backgrounds, restrained color transitions, and low-resoluti
skills.why_zh: 按像素海报的格点重排主题，边要齐，色要少。
skills.why_en: Not just prompts—it renders the bitmap too, with 3:4 composition and tight subject-text spacing enforced, avoiding the usual.
skills.limit_zh: 要高清写实、要渐变插画，格会对不上。
skills.limit_en: Only 3:4 portrait; needs a describable theme/mood/photo, not raw specs. Output is low-res bitmap (not vector); no 300dpi print files or local edits.
skills.title_en: Turn any theme into a 3:4 pixel poster + bitmap

skills.name: ian-xiaohei-illustrations
skills.title_zh: 给中文文章画手绘感解释图
skills.tagline_zh: 写完文章配图最头疼：截图太丑、AI 插画太飘。它专画流程、结构、隐喻——16:9 白底手绘，少量红橙蓝批注。
skills.tagline_en: Ian-style illustrations for Chinese article bodies — 16:9 hand-drawn on white with sparse red-orange-blue annotations, built for processes, structures, metaphors and arguments.
skills.desc_en: 生成 Ian 风格的中文正文配图。用于用户要求为中文文章、帖子、博客、Notion 文档、工作流文档、方法论、流程、结构、状态、隐喻或观点生成“怪诞”“小黑”“手绘”“正文配图”“文章插图”“配图建议”“shot list”“去标题/改图”等任务；默认使用小黑 IP、纯白手绘、少量红橙蓝批注、简洁清爽但天马行空的视觉风格。
skills.why_zh: 「单一明确风格」的典范：不给你一堆选项，一种腔调做到底，所以全篇视觉统一。
skills.why_en: A model of committing to one look: no menu of options, one voice held all the way through, which is why a whole article stays visually coherent.
skills.limit_zh: 出图靠宿主内置的 image_gen，没这条能力就画不了。风格锁死 16:9、纯白底、小黑当主体，不给第二种选。图上中文批注由模型写，正文把错字严重列进重生成条件。
skills.limit_en: Rendering needs the host's built-in `image_gen`. The look is locked: 16:9, white ground, Xiaohei as the actor, no alternatives. The Chinese annotations are drawn by the model, and its QA list makes bad characters grounds for a re-roll.
skills.title_en: Article diagrams that look like one hand drew them

skills.name: deep-research
skills.title_zh: 八步把模糊问题走成一份可引用的调研报告
skills.tagline_zh: 想调研一个话题，AI 却给你一篇维基摘要？这套八步法逼它先拆问题再找料，产出的是能拿去做决策的报告，不是概述。
skills.tagline_en: Wang Shuyi's eight-step research methodology — turns a vague topic into a high-quality research report; "research this for me" triggers it.
skills.desc_en: 深度调研方法论（8步法）：将模糊主题转化为高质量调研报告。 触发词：/deep-research、深度调研、帮我调研、调研一下、对比分析 注意：如果用户需要的是可视化图谱而非报告，请使用 research-to-diagram skill。
skills.why_zh: 作者高校教师出身、常年教研究方法，这八步是真在带学生做研究时用的那套，不是拍脑袋编的流程。
skills.why_en: By a university teacher who has taught research method for years — these eight steps come from actually supervising research, not from a whiteboard.

install.note_zh: 两件不同的 skill 在 frontmatter 里都叫 deep-research —— 生态是扁平命名空间，同名就会互相静默覆盖。这里加了作者前缀消歧，跟作者仓库里的原名不一致是故意的。

skills.limit_zh: 产物写死在 ~/Downloads/research/<主题>/，打包成 ~/outcome.tar.gz。Step 6.5 硬卡：必须另起独立 Agent 复核事实与推导，派不出子代理就卡住。全程靠 WebSearch。
skills.limit_en: Working dir is hardcoded to ~/Downloads/research/<topic>/, packed into ~/outcome.tar.gz. Step 6.5 is BLOCKING: a separate Agent must audit the fact cards and reasoning, so no sub-agent means no report. Needs live WebSearch.
skills.title_en: 8 steps from vague question to citable report

skills.name: gc-minimal-zine-poster-v0-3
skills.title_zh: 纸感诗性海报生成器，留白与单色点睛
skills.tagline_zh: 大留白、一处拼贴、一个色彩重音
skills.tagline_en: Hand it a sentence, an article, a mood or a photo and get a paper-textured minimal zine poster — vast negative space, one small collage anchor, experimental typography, a single clear color accent.
skills.desc_en: Generate or analyze poetic paper-texture minimal zine posters with large negative space, a small editorial collage or visual anchor, experimental typography, and one clear color accent. Use when the user gives a theme, sentence, article, mood, object, photo, content brief, reference images, or an image folder and wants a final poster image, a production-ready image prompt, reusable style rules, or
skills.why_zh: 卖的是克制。带自测集，作者在维护风格一致性。
skills.why_en: Rare in that what it sells is restraint — the hardest thing for a prompt to reproduce reliably. It ships an eval set, so the author is actually maintaining that consistency.
skills.limit_zh: 只出竖版纸感海报。字必须短，长文案会写糊。
skills.limit_en: Needs a built-in image tool, fed by referenced_image_paths or at most five in-session images. One form only: vertical, paper-textured, heavy negative space. Keep poster text short — image models garble long copy. On a fidelity miss it regenerates once, then says outright that it failed.
skills.title_en: Poetic paper-texture poster maker with bold whitespace

skills.name: moonlit-book-workflow
skills.title_zh: 给自家孩子做一本带家长配音的绘本
skills.tagline_zh: 12 页同一张脸，用你的声音读完
skills.tagline_en: Makes a 12-page personalized English picture book for your kid — a fixed watercolor house style plus a per-book character sheet keeps the child looking like the same character across all pages, narrated in a parent's own cloned voice, shipped as one sendable HTML file.
skills.desc_en: Build or resume a reusable 12-page personalized English picture book in a fixed watercolor house style, with a per-book character sheet for illustration consistency and local authorized-adult voice cloning for narration.
skills.why_zh: 固定水彩画风加角色设定图，保证每页都是同一个小孩，再用你自己的声音朗读，出一个能发出去的文件。

skills.limit_en: It produces an English picture book — Chinese needs another pass. Costs scale with pages since it calls an image model and TTS; changing the style key or character sheet forces a full regeneration.
skills.title_en: A bedtime book read in your own cloned voice

skills.name: human-writing
